gs1:AdditionalProductClassificationDetai.label: Additional Product Classification Details
gs1:AdditionalProductClassificationDetai.description: A product classification for the product other than the Global Product Classification(GPC brick value).

gs1:AdditiveDetails.label: Additive Details
gs1:AdditiveDetails.description: A set of details about one of the additives within the product.

gs1:AllergenDetails.label: Allergen Details
gs1:AllergenDetails.description: Details of an allergen for a product.

gs1:AuthenticityDetails.label: Authenticity Details
gs1:AuthenticityDetails.description: A set of details about covert or overt security features that may contribute to checking the authenticity of a product or product instance.

gs1:AwardPrizeDetails.label: Award Prize
gs1:AwardPrizeDetails.description: Describes a prize or award won by a product or organization.

gs1:Brand.label: Brand
gs1:Brand.description: Information on brands and sub-brands for a product.

gs1:CertificationDetails.label: Certification
gs1:CertificationDetails.description: Certification issued by a certifying body to a certification subject (Organization, Place, Product).

gs1:Clothing.label: Clothing
gs1:Clothing.description: A product that is worn on the body.

gs1:ColourCodeDetails.label: Colour Code Details
gs1:ColourCodeDetails.description: A set of colour code details (colour code, party controlling the code list) for the product.

gs1:CompulsoryAdditionalInformation.label: Compulsory Additional Information
gs1:CompulsoryAdditionalInformation.description: The group of compulsory information about a product.

gs1:ContactPoint.label: Contact
gs1:ContactPoint.description: Information on an individual or department acting as point of contact for an organiation.

gs1:Country.label: Country
gs1:Country.description: Country is a complex data type that indicates a country and a country subdivision.

gs1:DietTypeCodeDetails.label: Diet Type Code Details
gs1:DietTypeCodeDetails.description: A set of diet type code details (diet type code and diet type sub code) for the product.

gs1:Discount.label: Discount
gs1:Discount.description: Provides information on a discount applicable to an offer for example 2 percent.

gs1:FoodAndBeveragePreparationInformatio.label: Food and Beverage Preparation Information
gs1:FoodAndBeveragePreparationInformatio.description: Food and Beverage Preparation Information is a complex data type that indicates a preparation state code and preparation instructions.

gs1:FoodBeverageTobaccoIngredientDetails.label: Food Beverage Tobacco Ingredient
gs1:FoodBeverageTobaccoIngredientDetails.description: Food Beverage Tobacco Ingredient is a complex data type that includes an ingredient statement and details.

gs1:FoodBeverageTobaccoProduct.label: Food Beverage Tobacco Product
gs1:FoodBeverageTobaccoProduct.description: A food, beverage or tobacco product.

gs1:Footwear.label: Footwear
gs1:Footwear.description: Outerwear that is worn on the feet such as shoes or boots.

gs1:FruitsVegetables.label: Fruits and Vegetables
gs1:FruitsVegetables.description: Contains properties related specifically to fruit and vegetable products.

gs1:GeoCoordinates.label: GeoCoordinates
gs1:GeoCoordinates.description: The geographic coordinates of a place or event.

gs1:GeoShape.label: GeoShape
gs1:GeoShape.description: The geographic shape of a place. A GeoShape can be described using several properties whose values are based on latitude/longitude pairs. Either whitespace or commas can be used to separate latitude and longitude; whitespace should be used when writing a list of several such points.

gs1:LocationID_Details.label: Location ID Details
gs1:LocationID_Details.description: Government bodies, trade organisations, and other parties issue identifiers that are associated to locations. Linking these identifiers to GLN and one another supports consolidating records, mapping related, collaborative identifiers, enhances search ability and enables more efficient transitions between identifiers. This class provides a mechanism for connecting and sharing location identifiers.

gs1:LocationStatusHistory.label: Location Status History
gs1:LocationStatusHistory.description: Over the lifetime of a location, it may go through periods of being active and inactive. gs1:LocationStatusHistory allows changes in status to be communicated in advance and tracked over time.

gs1:Message.label: Message
gs1:Message.description: Any kind of electronic message for communication of information from one party to one or more other parties.

gs1:MilkButterCreamYogurtCheeseEggsSubst.label: Milk Butter Cream Yogurt Cheese Eggs Substitutes
gs1:MilkButterCreamYogurtCheeseEggsSubst.description: Milk butter cream yogurts cheese eggs and any substitutes for these products.

gs1:NutritionMeasurementType.label: Nutrition Measurement Type
gs1:NutritionMeasurementType.description: A class providing nutritional value and intake percent.

gs1:Offer.label: Offer
gs1:Offer.description: An offer to transfer some rights to an item or to provide a service,for example, an offer to sell tickets to an event, to rent the DVD of a movie, to stream a TV show over the internet, to repair a motorcycle, or to loan a book.

gs1:OrganicClaimDetails.label: Organic Claim Details
gs1:OrganicClaimDetails.description: A set of organic claim details for the product.

gs1:Organization.label: Organization
gs1:Organization.description: An Organization is any legal or physical entity involved at any point in any supply chain and upon which there is a need to retrieve predefined information. An Organization is uniquely identified by a Global Location Number (GLN).

gs1:OrganizationClassificationDetails.label: Organization Classification Details
gs1:OrganizationClassificationDetails.description: Government bodies, trade organisations, and other parties have developed taxonomies that classify business sectors, activities, and other organisational classifications. This class provides a A repeatable grouping of classification details for an organisation.

gs1:OrganizationID_Details.label: Organisation ID Details
gs1:OrganizationID_Details.description: Government bodies, trade organisations, and other parties issue identifiers that are associated to legal entities and/or functions. Linking these identifiers to GLN and one another supports consolidating records, mapping related, collaborative identifiers, enhances search ability and enables more efficient transitions between identifiers. This class provides a mechanism for connecting and sharing party identifiers.

gs1:OrganizationStatusHistory.label: Organisation Status History
gs1:OrganizationStatusHistory.description: Over the lifetime of an organisation, it may go through periods of being active and inactive. gs1:OrganizationStatusHistory allows changes in status to be communicated in advance and tracked over time.

gs1:PackagingDetails.label: Packaging
gs1:PackagingDetails.description: Details on packaging for a product for example packaging type (bottle), materials, features, recycling, etc..

gs1:PackagingMaterialDetails.label: Packaging Material Details
gs1:PackagingMaterialDetails.description: Information on any material used for packaging.

gs1:Place.label: Place
gs1:Place.description: Entities that have a somewhat fixed, physical location.

gs1:PostalAddress.label: Address
gs1:PostalAddress.description: The location at which a particular organization or person may be found or reached.

gs1:PriceSpecification.label: Price Specification
gs1:PriceSpecification.description: A structured value representing a monetary amount, consisting of a value and currency code.

gs1:Product.label: Product
gs1:Product.description: Any item (product or service) upon which there is a need to retrieve pre-defined information and that may be priced, or ordered, or invoiced at any point in any supply chain.

gs1:ProductYieldDetails.label: Product Yield Details
gs1:ProductYieldDetails.description: A grouping of properties related to the yield of a food or beverage product according to a specified type of preparation.

gs1:QuantitativeValue.label: Measurement Type
gs1:QuantitativeValue.description: A point value or interval for product characteristics and other purposes. A unit of measurement is also specified.

gs1:ReferencedFileDetails.label: Referenced File
gs1:ReferencedFileDetails.description: Provides URL and other information on a referenced electronic file.

gs1:RegulatoryIdentifier.label: Regulatory Identifier
gs1:RegulatoryIdentifier.description: A repeatable grouping of identifiers that reference one document, record or dataset within one regulatory information system, repository or registry

gs1:RegulatoryInformation.label: Regulatory Information
gs1:RegulatoryInformation.description: Information on applicable government regulations applicable to a trade item

gs1:RegulatoryNotification.label: Regulatory Notification
gs1:RegulatoryNotification.description: A notification message about information on applicable government regulations applicable to a trade item

gs1:ReturnablePackageDepositDetails.label: Returnable Package Deposit Details
gs1:ReturnablePackageDepositDetails.description: Details of the deposit for returnable packaging for a product.

gs1:Seafood.label: Seafood
gs1:Seafood.description: Seafood Products including fish and shellfish.

gs1:SizeCodeDetails.label: Size Code Details
gs1:SizeCodeDetails.description: A grouping of properties related to the representing the size of a product, by specifying a value from a specified code list.

gs1:SizeDetails.label: Size Details
gs1:SizeDetails.description: A grouping of properties related to the size of a wearable product

gs1:TargetMarketDetails.label: Target Market Details
gs1:TargetMarketDetails.description: A set of target market details (product release date and associated countries) for the product.

gs1:TextileMaterialDetails.label: Textile Material
gs1:TextileMaterialDetails.description: Details on the composition of any materials used to make a product using textiles.

gs1:Transaction.label: Transaction
gs1:Transaction.description: A repeatable grouping of identifiers that identify a business transaction ID and its type

gs1:WarrantyPromise.label: Warranty
gs1:WarrantyPromise.description: An assurance that the product is reliable and that repairs or replacement will be done free of charge within a given time limit and under certain conditions in the event of a defect.

gs1:WearableProduct.label: Wearable Product
gs1:WearableProduct.description: Products that are worn on the body.

gs1:CertificationStatus.label: Certification Status Code
gs1:CertificationStatus.description: A set of codes for the status of a certification instance

gs1:CompulsoryAdditionalLabelInformation.label: Compulsory Additional Label Information Type Code
gs1:CompulsoryAdditionalLabelInformation.description: The code indicating the type of the legally required/compulsory additional information that is stated on the product packaging or label.

gs1:GLN_TypeCode.label: GLN Type Code
gs1:GLN_TypeCode.description: GLN Type Code indicates what type of thing is being identified by a GLN. gs1:GLN_TypeCode value selections SHALL NOT contain both gs1:GLN_TypeCode-FIXED_PHYSICAL_LOCATION and gs1:GLN_TypeCode-MOBILE_PHYSICAL_LOCATION.

gs1:LocationRoleType.label: Location Role Code
gs1:LocationRoleType.description: Indicates the role and/or purpose of a location (i.e., fixed or mobile physical location or digital location) identified with a GLN.

gs1:MeasurementType.label: Measurement type
gs1:MeasurementType.description: A set of measurement types for properties that can be measured or sensed by appropriate measuring devices or sensors

gs1:OrganizationClassificationType.label: Organization Classification Type
gs1:OrganizationClassificationType.description: A code value indicating a specific taxonomy that classifies business sectors, activities, and other organisational classifications. National Classification systems are often based on global or regional Classification systems (e.g., ISIC, SIC, NACE). If so, the national system extends the international system adding new or longer code values. In case the code value from the local system is in fact the same as in the international system, it is highly recommended to use the Organization Classification Type for the international system rather than that for the national system. By using the international code, many more organisation will be able to interpret the code value used easily and correctly.

gs1:PaymentMethod.label: Payment Method Code
gs1:PaymentMethod.description: A code indicating an accepted method of payment

gs1:PreparationTypeCode.label: Preparation Type Code
gs1:PreparationTypeCode.description: A code indicating a method of preparation of a food or beverage product

gs1:RegulationTypeCode.label: Regulation Type Code
gs1:RegulationTypeCode.description: The code indicating a type of regulation.

gs1:RegulatoryIdentifierType.label: Regulatory Identifier Type
gs1:RegulatoryIdentifierType.description: A code indicating the regulatory purpose of a referenced record, document or dataset.

gs1:SensorAlertType.label: Sensor Alert Type
gs1:SensorAlertType.description: A code list for reasons for generating a sensor alert, including an alarm condition or an error condition

gs1:TransactionType.label: Transaction Type
gs1:TransactionType.description: A code indicating the type or purpose of a transaction identifier.

gs1:acceptedPaymentMethod.label: Accepted Payment Method
gs1:acceptedPaymentMethod.description: Code indicating a means of payment, for example, BANK_CHEQUE, CASH, etc.

gs1:activityIdeas.label: Activity Ideas
gs1:activityIdeas.description: A link to ideas for using a product or engaging in other forms of entertainment, particularly with children.

gs1:additionalLocationID.label: Has Additional Location ID
gs1:additionalLocationID.description: Location identifiers assigned and managed by government bodies, trade organisations, and other entities.

gs1:additionalOrganizationID.label: Has Additional Organization ID
gs1:additionalOrganizationID.description: Party/organisation identifiers assigned and managed by government bodies, trade organisations, and other entities.

gs1:additionalOrganizationIdentification.label: Additional Organization Identification Type Value
gs1:additionalOrganizationIdentification.description: The value associated with the Additional Organization Identification Type Value.

gs1:additionalProductClassification.label: Has Additional Product Classification
gs1:additionalProductClassification.description: Relates to a set of additional product classification details

gs1:additionalProductClassificationCode.label: Additional Product Classification Code
gs1:additionalProductClassificationCode.description: Code specifying the applied additional product classification scheme.

gs1:additionalProductClassificationCodeD.label: Additional Product Classification Code Description
gs1:additionalProductClassificationCodeD.description: A description related to the additional product classification code value.

gs1:additionalProductClassificationValue.label: Additional Product Classification Value
gs1:additionalProductClassificationValue.description: Code specifying an additional product classification other than the GS1 Global Product Classification. The applied classification scheme is specified as additional information together with the classification value.

gs1:additionalProductDescription.label: Additional Product Description
gs1:additionalProductDescription.description: Additional variants necessary to communicate to the industry to help define the product. Multiple variants can be established for each GTIN for e.g. Style, Colour, and Fragrance .

gs1:additive.label: Has Additive
gs1:additive.description: Relates to details about any additives that a product may contain.

gs1:additiveLevelOfContainment.label: Additive Level Of Containment
gs1:additiveLevelOfContainment.description: Code indicating the level of presence of the additive.

gs1:additiveName.label: Additive Name
gs1:additiveName.description: The name of any additive or genetic modification contained or not contained in the product .

gs1:address.label: Has Postal Address
gs1:address.description: The postal address for an organization or place.

gs1:addressCountry.label: Address Country
gs1:addressCountry.description: Code specifying the country (and country subdivision) for the address using ISO 3166-1.

gs1:addressLocality.label: Address Locality
gs1:addressLocality.description: Text specifying the name of the locality, for example a city.

gs1:addressRegion.label: Province State Code
gs1:addressRegion.description: Text specifying a province or state in abbreviated format for example NJ.

gs1:addressSuburb.label: Address Suburb
gs1:addressSuburb.description: A suburb within a town or city.

gs1:affiliatedTo.label: Affiliated to
gs1:affiliatedTo.description: Method for associating an organisation/party affiliated to the identified organisation e.g., when engaged in an agent relationship (insurance, shipping, etc).

gs1:afterHoursContact.label: Has After Hours Contact
gs1:afterHoursContact.description: Links to after-hours contact information. For general contact details, gs1:contactPoint SHALL be used.

gs1:alcoholicBeverageSubregion.label: Alcoholic Beverage Sub-region
gs1:alcoholicBeverageSubregion.description: A legally defined geographical region where the grapes for a wine were grown also known as an appellation. It is recommended to populate this property with an ISO 3166-2 code to indicate country and subdivision.

gs1:allergenInfo.label: Allergen information
gs1:allergenInfo.description: A link to a description of the allergen information.

gs1:allergenLevelOfContainmentCode.label: Allergen Level Of Containment
gs1:allergenLevelOfContainmentCode.description: Code specifying the level of presence of the allergen.

gs1:allergenSpecificationAgency.label: Allergen Specification Agency
gs1:allergenSpecificationAgency.description: The agency or other organization that defines or manages the criteria for allergen containment.

gs1:allergenSpecificationName.label: Allergen Specification Name
gs1:allergenSpecificationName.description: Free text field containing the name and version of the regulation or standard that defines the criteria of allergen containment.

gs1:allergenStatement.label: Allergen Statement
gs1:allergenStatement.description: Textual description of the presence or absence of allergens as governed by local rules and regulations, specified as one string.

gs1:allergenType.label: Allergen Type Code
gs1:allergenType.description: Code specifying the type of allergen.

gs1:anatomicalForm.label: Anatomical Form
gs1:anatomicalForm.description: Describes the meat product in terms of whether it is the whole animal or part of the animal which has been cut such as the muscle, bone, organ, or fat.

gs1:appDownload.label: App download
gs1:appDownload.description: A link to a related mobile app

gs1:applicableProducts.label: Applicable Products
gs1:applicableProducts.description: The set of product identifiers for which this regulatory notification message applies.

gs1:applicableTo.label: Applicable to
gs1:applicableTo.description: A property linking a gs1:linkType to the primary GS1 key(s) for which it can be used. Similar to rdfs:Domain but the value space is a GS1 Application Identifier, not a class.

gs1:applicableTransactions.label: Applicable Transactions
gs1:applicableTransactions.description: References one or more business transactions

gs1:audioFile.label: Has Audio File
gs1:audioFile.description: Link to a file containing an audio clip which is relevant to the product. Examples are commercials, or instructional/ how to use audio files.

gs1:authenticity.label: Has Authenticity Details
gs1:authenticity.description: Links to details of covert/overt security markings that may be used to check authenticity of a product instance.

gs1:authenticitySecurityFeatureInstructi.label: Authenticity Security Feature Instructions
gs1:authenticitySecurityFeatureInstructi.description: Provides human-readable instructions about how to locate a physical security marking and read a value from it.

gs1:authenticitySecurityFeatureInstructi.label: Authenticity Security Feature Instructions Link
gs1:authenticitySecurityFeatureInstructi.description: Links to online instructions about how to locate a physical security marking and read a value from it.

gs1:authenticitySecurityFeatureRegularEx.label: Authenticity Security Feature Regular Expression
gs1:authenticitySecurityFeatureRegularEx.description: Links to a regular expression to be used to perform syntax validation (plausibility checking) of a string value read from a physical security marking.

gs1:authenticitySecurityFeatureType.label: Authenticity Security Feature Type
gs1:authenticitySecurityFeatureType.description: Links to a URI code value indicating a particular type of physical security marking.

gs1:authenticitySecurityFeatureValue.label: Authenticity Security Feature Value
gs1:authenticitySecurityFeatureValue.description: Links to a string value read from a physical security marking.

gs1:availabilityEnds.label: Availability Ends
gs1:availabilityEnds.description: The date from which the product is no longer available from the information provider, including seasonal or temporary product and services .

gs1:availabilityStarts.label: Availability Starts
gs1:availabilityStarts.description: The date from which the product is available from the information provider, including seasonal or temporary product and services.

gs1:availableAtOrFrom.label: Available At/From
gs1:availableAtOrFrom.description: The location the offered product or service is available from.

gs1:availableLanguage.label: Available Language
gs1:availableLanguage.description: ISO 639-1 code specifying the language of a specified contact point.

gs1:awardPrize.label: Has Award Prize
gs1:awardPrize.description: An award or prize given to the product.

gs1:awardPrizeCode.label: Award Prize Code
gs1:awardPrizeCode.description: Indicates the achievement of the product in relation to a prize or award, e.g. winner, runner-up, shortlisted.

gs1:awardPrizeCountryCode.label: Award Prize Country Code
gs1:awardPrizeCountryCode.description: An ISO standard code identifying the country in which a prize or award is given. It is recommended to populate this property with an ISO 3166-1 country code.

gs1:awardPrizeDescription.label: Award Prize Description
gs1:awardPrizeDescription.description: Text that describes the awards won.

gs1:awardPrizeJury.label: Award Prize Jury
gs1:awardPrizeJury.description: Free text listing members of the jury that awarded the prize.

gs1:awardPrizeName.label: Award Prize Name
gs1:awardPrizeName.description: The name of a prize or award which the product has received.

gs1:awardPrizeYear.label: Award Prize Year
gs1:awardPrizeYear.description: The year in which a prize or award was given.

gs1:backgroundInfo.label: Background Information
gs1:backgroundInfo.description: A link to information typically from the owner of the identified entity about the creative background, thought leadership or influence of the identified entity. This may include the inspiration, innovation for a development process, literary approach or, the science or technology used.

gs1:baseLocation.label: Base Location
gs1:baseLocation.description: A fixed physical location where a mobile location most commonly resides. If gs1:glnType is present, gs1:baseLocationGLN SHALL only be used when gs1:glnType is gs1:GLN_TypeCode-MOBILE_PHYSICAL_LOCATION

gs1:bestBeforeDate.label: Best Before Date
gs1:bestBeforeDate.description: Best before date on the label or package signifies the end of the period under which the product will retain specific quality attributes or claims even though the product may continue to retain positive quality attributes after this date. Best before date is primarily used for consumer information and may be a regulatory requirement.

gs1:beverageVintage.label: Beverage Vintage
gs1:beverageVintage.description: The year in which the majority of ingredients are harvested and/or the alcoholic beverage is produced. Determination as to whether the vintage year is the harvest date or production date is according to requirements in the Target Market.

gs1:biotinPerNutrientBasis.label: Biotin Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:biotinPerNutrientBasis.description: Biotin Acid per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:bonelessClaim.label: Boneless Claim
gs1:bonelessClaim.description: The descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify whether the product makes a specific claim to contain no bones.

gs1:brand.label: Has Brand
gs1:brand.description: The brand of the product that appears on the consumer package.

gs1:brandHomepageClinical.label: Information for professionals about this brand
gs1:brandHomepageClinical.description: A link to a brand presence aimed at clinical professionals.

gs1:brandHomepagePatient.label: Information for patients about this brand
gs1:brandHomepagePatient.description: A link to a brand presence aimed at patients.

gs1:brandName.label: Brand Name
gs1:brandName.description: The brand name of the product that appears on the consumer package.

gs1:brandOwner.label: Has Brand Owner
gs1:brandOwner.description: The brand owner of the product. The organization that is responsible for allocating the GTIN to the product.

gs1:businessEntity.label: Has Business Entity
gs1:businessEntity.description: Method for noting business structure (e.g., Limited liability company, not for profit). Expects a repeatable value from gs1:BusinessEntityType code list.

gs1:calciumPerNutrientBasis.label: Calcium Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:calciumPerNutrientBasis.description: Calcium per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:carbohydratesPerNutrientBasis.label: Carbohydrates Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:carbohydratesPerNutrientBasis.description: Carbohydrates per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:careersInfo.label: Careers information
gs1:careersInfo.description: A link to information about jobs, careers, or other employment opportunities associated to an organisation or location.

gs1:catchZone.label: Catch Zone
gs1:catchZone.description: Free text field describing the sea zone from which the product was caught in.

gs1:certification.label: Has Certification
gs1:certification.description: Certification information about a product, organisation or location.

gs1:certificationAgency.label: Certification Agency
gs1:certificationAgency.description: Name of the organisation issuing the certification standard or other requirement being met .

gs1:certificationAgencyURL.label: Certification Agency URL
gs1:certificationAgencyURL.description: URL of the organisation issuing the certification standard or other requirement being met. e.g. https://www.msc.org , https://www.fsc.org

gs1:certificationAuditDate.label: Certification Audit Date
gs1:certificationAuditDate.description: Date of completion of the auditing needed for certification

gs1:certificationEndDate.label: Certification End Date
gs1:certificationEndDate.description: Last date of validity for the certification. (After this date the certification lapses and would need to be renewed/replaced)

gs1:certificationIdentification.label: Certification Identification
gs1:certificationIdentification.description: A reference (i.e, to a certificate instance) issued to confirm that a product, party or location has passed certification. e.g. 'XSC-C-12345'

gs1:certificationStandard.label: Certification Standard
gs1:certificationStandard.description: Name of the certification standard. Free text. Example: 'Egg classification' .

gs1:certificationStartDate.label: Certification Start Date
gs1:certificationStartDate.description: First date of validity for the certification

gs1:certificationStatement.label: Certification Statement
gs1:certificationStatement.description: Certification scope statement of the individual certification instance. The same certificationStandard can be issued with different values of certificationStatement in different instances.

gs1:certificationStatus.label: Certification Status
gs1:certificationStatus.description: Indicates the current status of the certification, e.g. active or inactive.

gs1:certificationSubject.label: Certification Subject
gs1:certificationSubject.description: References the object (e.g. product, asset, container), party or location being certified. If multiple values are specified, the certification details apply to the logical conjunction (AND) of groups of different types, while a logical disjunction (OR) applies within each group of the same type. For example, two sibling organisations O1 and O2 can process products P1 and P2 at locations L1 and L2: meaning that either organisation can process either product at either location (OR); but the certificate holds for the combinations of organisation (either O1 OR O2) AND product (either P1 OR P2) AND location (either L1 OR L2)

gs1:certificationURI.label: Certification URI
gs1:certificationURI.description: If gs1:certificationURI is present, it should point to data about this individual certificate within a repository maintained by the certification agency.

gs1:cheeseFirmness.label: Cheese Firmness
gs1:cheeseFirmness.description: The firmness of the cheese product for example EXTRA_HARD.

gs1:cheeseMaturationPeriodDescription.label: Cheese Maturation Period Description
gs1:cheeseMaturationPeriodDescription.description: A descriptive way to specify a date range as some cheeses are matured over a period of time, but not an exact period. For example 3 to 4 weeks, over 1 year etc. The term maturation is also known in other markets as Aged.

gs1:chloridePerNutrientBasis.label: Chloride Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:chloridePerNutrientBasis.description: Chloride per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:cholesterolPerNutrientBasis.label: Cholesterol Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:cholesterolPerNutrientBasis.description: Cholesterol per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:chromiumPerNutrientBasis.label: Chromium Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:chromiumPerNutrientBasis.description: Chromium per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:circle.label: Circle
gs1:circle.description: A circle is the circular region of a specified radius centred at a specified latitude and longitude. A circle is expressed as a pair followed by a radius in meters.

gs1:clothingCut.label: Clothing Cut
gs1:clothingCut.description: Supplemental information to indicate the clothing cut or silhouette make of the garment. For example, silhouette details for a pair of jeans such as boot cut, or loose fit, comfort fit.

gs1:collarType.label: Collar Type
gs1:collarType.description: A free text description of the type of collar on the garment.

gs1:colourCode.label: Has Colour Code
gs1:colourCode.description: Relates to a set of details about the colour code for a product

gs1:colourCodeList.label: Colour Code List
gs1:colourCodeList.description: The parties controlling the colour code lists. Dependent on colour code value.

gs1:colourCodeValue.label: Colour Code
gs1:colourCodeValue.description: A code indicating the colour of an object according to a specific code list. The applied code list is specified as additional information together with the colour code.

gs1:colourDescription.label: Colour Description
gs1:colourDescription.description: A description of the colour of an object.

gs1:companyFilingURL.label: Company Filing URL
gs1:companyFilingURL.description: A URI value linking to information related to organisation filing details.

gs1:compulsoryAdditionalInformation.label: Compulsory Additional Information
gs1:compulsoryAdditionalInformation.description: The legally required/compulsory additional label information as stated on the product packaging or label.

gs1:compulsoryAdditionalLabelInformation.label: Compulsory Additional Label Information
gs1:compulsoryAdditionalLabelInformation.description: The legally required/compulsory additional label information as stated on the product packaging or label.

gs1:compulsoryAdditionalLabelInformation.label: Compulsory Additional Label Information Type
gs1:compulsoryAdditionalLabelInformation.description: The code indicating the type of the legally required/compulsory additional information that is stated on the product packaging label.

gs1:consumerFirstAvailabilityDateTime.label: Consumer First Availability Date Time
gs1:consumerFirstAvailabilityDateTime.description: The first date/time that the buyer is allowed to sell the product to consumers. Usually related to a specific geography. ISO 8601 date format CCYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.

gs1:consumerHandlingStorage.label: Has Consumer Handling Storage
gs1:consumerHandlingStorage.description: Link to a website, file, or image containing the manufacturer's recommendations for how the consumer or end user should store and handle the product.

gs1:consumerHandlingStorageInfo.label: Consumer handling and storage information
gs1:consumerHandlingStorageInfo.description: A link to information about safe handling and storage for consumer use.

gs1:consumerLifestage.label: Consumer Lifestage
gs1:consumerLifestage.description: Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the period or stage in the consumer's life during which the product is considered to be suitable.

gs1:consumerPackageDisclaimer.label: Consumer Package Disclaimer
gs1:consumerPackageDisclaimer.description: Additional information that should be used in advertising and in displaying.

gs1:consumerProductVariant.label: Consumer Product Variant
gs1:consumerProductVariant.description: The consumer product variant may be used to distinguish one variant of a retail consumer trade item from another if the change does not require the allocation of a different Global Trade Item Number (per the GTIN Management Standard), but communication between trading partners is required to support consumers. The brand owner is responsible for assigning the consumer product variant.

gs1:consumerRecyclingInstructions.label: Consumer Recycling Instructions
gs1:consumerRecyclingInstructions.description: Expresses in text the consumer recycling instructions which are normally held on the label or accompanying the product. Instructions may refer to the 'how' the consumer is supposed to sort the product and packaging materials for recycling.

gs1:consumerSafetyInformation.label: Consumer Safety Information
gs1:consumerSafetyInformation.description: Information on consumer safety regarding the product.

gs1:consumerSalesCondition.label: Consumer Sales Condition Code
gs1:consumerSalesCondition.description: A code indicating restrictions imposed on the product regarding how it can be sold to the consumer for example Prescription Required.

gs1:consumerStorageInstructions.label: Consumer Storage Instructions
gs1:consumerStorageInstructions.description: Expresses in text the consumer storage instructions of a product which are normally held on the label or accompanying the product. This information may or may not be labelled on the pack.

gs1:consumerUsageInstructions.label: Consumer Usage Instructions
gs1:consumerUsageInstructions.description: Free text containing the usage instructions of a product, which are normally held on the label or accompanying the product. This information may or may not be labelled on the pack.

gs1:contactPoint.label: Has Business Contact
gs1:contactPoint.description: Contact information. To specify a contact specifically designated for after-hours support, see gs1:afterHoursContact

gs1:contactRoleCode.label: Has Contact Role Code
gs1:contactRoleCode.description: The function or role of a contact. Value from gs1:ContactRoleType code list.

gs1:contactTitle.label: Contact Title
gs1:contactTitle.description: The job title of the person that can be contacted for example Manager.

gs1:contactType.label: Contact Type
gs1:contactType.description: The function or role of a contact for example Customer Support.

gs1:containedInPlace.label: Contained in Place
gs1:containedInPlace.description: Designates the larger physical location a sub-location is located within. To specify sub-locations of a physical location, see gs1:containsPlace.

gs1:containsPlace.label: Contains Place
gs1:containsPlace.description: Designates a sub-location (e.g., floor, room, shelf) within the physical location being identified. There may be multiple sub-locations associated to a single, physical location. To specify the larger physical location the sub-location is located within, see gs1:containedInPlace

gs1:convenienceLevelPercent.label: Convenience Level Percent
gs1:convenienceLevelPercent.description: An indication of the ease of preparation for semi-prepared products. The convenience level indicates the level of preparation in percentage required to prepare and helps the consumer to assess how long it will take to prepare the meal.

gs1:coordinateReferenceSystem.label: Coordinate Reference System
gs1:coordinateReferenceSystem.description: Open standard spatial reference systems or coordinate reference systems that provide coordinate-based local, regional or global system used to locate geographical entities. Values should be URIs already defined by the IOPG Geomatics Committee (https://epsg.org/), such as https://epsg.io/4326 (WGS84); https://epsg.io/4267 (NAD27); https://epsg.io/4230 (ED50); https://epsg.io/4618 (SAD69); https://epsg.io/4269 (NAD83). For elevation values, gs1:elevation SHALL be used.

gs1:copperPerNutrientBasis.label: Copper Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:copperPerNutrientBasis.description: Copper per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:countryCode.label: Country Code
gs1:countryCode.description: Code specifying the country for the address using ISO 3166-1.

gs1:countryOfAssembly.label: Has Country Of Assembly
gs1:countryOfAssembly.description: The place where product is assembled.

gs1:countryOfLastProcessing.label: Has Country Of Last Processing
gs1:countryOfLastProcessing.description: The place where the product or ingredient was last processed and tested before importation.

gs1:countryOfOrigin.label: Has Country Of Origin
gs1:countryOfOrigin.description: Code indicating the country of origin of the product.

gs1:countryOfOriginStatement.label: Country Of Origin Statement
gs1:countryOfOriginStatement.description: A description of the geographic area the item may have originated from or has been processed.

gs1:countrySubdivisionCode.label: Country Subdivision Code
gs1:countrySubdivisionCode.description: A short text string code (see values defined in ISO 3166_2) specifying the country subdivision in which an activity is performed, for example processing, bottling, manufacturing.

gs1:countyCode.label: County Code
gs1:countyCode.description: A code that identifies a county. A county is a territorial division in some countries, forming the chief unit of local administration. In the US, a county is a political and administrative division of a state.

gs1:crossStreet.label: Cross Street
gs1:crossStreet.description: A street intersecting a main street (usually at right angles) and continuing on both sides of it.

gs1:csrAffiliation.label: Corporate Social Responsibility Affiliation
gs1:csrAffiliation.description: A URI value linking to information related to social responsibility activities and associations that an organisation/party is involved with.

gs1:customerSupportCentre.label: Has Customer Support Centre
gs1:customerSupportCentre.description: The organization which provides product support to the trading partner organization to which merchandise is sold.

gs1:dailyValueIntakePercent.label: Daily Value Intake Percent
gs1:dailyValueIntakePercent.description: The percentage of the recommended daily intake of a nutrient as recommended by authorities of the target market. Is expressed relative to the serving size and base daily value intake.

gs1:defaultLink.label: Default link
gs1:defaultLink.description: The default link for a given identified item to which a resolver will redirect unless there is information in the request that is a better match.

gs1:defaultLinkMulti.label: Default linkMulti
gs1:defaultLinkMulti.description: A set of 'default links' that may be differentiated by information in the HTTP request headers sent to a resolver to enable a better match than the single default link.

gs1:department.label: Department
gs1:department.description: The name of a division of an organization dealing with a specific activity

gs1:dependentProprietaryProduct.label: Has Dependent Proprietary Product
gs1:dependentProprietaryProduct.description: Dependent products are products which are required to make the current product functional.

gs1:descriptiveSize.label: Descriptive Size
gs1:descriptiveSize.description: An alphanumeric size factor the brand owner wishes to communicate to the consumer. IE Jumbo, Capri, Full Length, Maxi.

gs1:dietCode.label: Diet Code
gs1:dietCode.description: Links to multiple pairs of gs1:DietTypeCode and diet type sub code (free-form text string).

gs1:dietType.label: Diet Type Code
gs1:dietType.description: Code indicating the diet the product is suitable for example Kosher.

gs1:dietTypeDescription.label: Diet Type Description
gs1:dietTypeDescription.description: Free text for indication of diet not stated in the list of diets.

gs1:dietTypeSubcode.label: Diet Type Sub-code
gs1:dietTypeSubcode.description: Indicates a set of agreements or a certificate name that guarantees the product is permitted in a particular diet. A diet type subcode is a subclassification of a specific diet type. For example, Pareve is a diet type subcode of Kosher.

gs1:digitalAddress.label: Has Digital Address
gs1:digitalAddress.description: The location reference associated to a digital place. If gs1:glnType is present, SHALL only be associated if the value of gs1:glnType is gs1:GLN_TypeCode-DIGITAL_LOCATION.

gs1:digitalLocationName.label: Digital Location Name
gs1:digitalLocationName.description: The name of a digital place. To specify the name of a physical location, see gs1:physicalLocationName.

gs1:discountRepeatsPerMultipleMinimum.label: Discount Repeats Per Multiple Minimum
gs1:discountRepeatsPerMultipleMinimum.description: If specified and set to true, the discount is available for each time the minimum qualifying criteria are met. This can be used to express '$10 off each $50 spend', which is distinct from a 20% discount because it is quantized in units of spending.

gs1:discountType.label: Discount Type
gs1:discountType.description: A code that specifies the type of payment discount applicable to an offer, for example BOGO.

gs1:dpp.label: Digital Product Passport
gs1:dpp.description: A link to a digital product passport.

gs1:drainedWeight.label: Drained Weight
gs1:drainedWeight.description: The weight of the product when drained of its liquid. For example 225 GRM, Jar of pickles in vinegar.

gs1:dueDate.label: Due Date
gs1:dueDate.description: The date by which an invoice should be paid. This data element represents an attribute of a payment slip reference number, AI (8020), and a Global Location Number (GLN) of the invoicing party.

gs1:durationOfWarranty.label: Duration Of Warranty
gs1:durationOfWarranty.description: The time period that the warranty is valid within.

gs1:dutyFeeTaxAmount.label: Duty Fee Tax Amount
gs1:dutyFeeTaxAmount.description: The current tax or duty or fee amount applicable to the product, expressed as a floating-point numeric value that is qualified by the corresponding currency. See also gs1:priceCurrency.

gs1:dutyFeeTaxDescription.label: Duty Fee Tax Description
gs1:dutyFeeTaxDescription.description: A description of tax type for example Taxes sure les supports audio.

gs1:dutyFeeTaxRate.label: Duty Fee Tax Rate
gs1:dutyFeeTaxRate.description: The current tax or duty rate percentage applicable to the product.

gs1:eifu.label: Electronic Instructions For Use
gs1:eifu.description: A link to electronic Instruction For Use instructions for Medical Devices.

gs1:elevation.label: Elevation
gs1:elevation.description: The elevation of a location (WGS 84). Values may be of the form 'NUMBER UNITOFMEASUREMENT' (e.g., '1,000 m', '3,200 ft') while numbers alone SHALL be a value in meters.

gs1:eligibleQuantity.label: Eligible Quantity
gs1:eligibleQuantity.description: The quantity including unit of measure for which the offer for good or service is valid. If this is not specified, an eligible quantity of 1 should be assumed.

gs1:eligibleQuantityMaximum.label: Eligible Quantity Maximum
gs1:eligibleQuantityMaximum.description: The maximum quantity including unit of measure for which the offer for good or service is valid.

gs1:eligibleQuantityMinimum.label: Eligible Quantity Minimum
gs1:eligibleQuantityMinimum.description: The minimum quantity including unit of measure for which the offer for good or service is valid.

gs1:eligibleTradeChannel.label: Eligible Trade Channel
gs1:eligibleTradeChannel.description: A code determining the location where a user can redeem the offer, for example ONLINE_ONLY.

gs1:email.label: E-mail
gs1:email.description: Creating/sending/receiving of unstructured free text messages or documents using computer network, a mini-computer or an attached modem and regular telephone line or other electronic transmission media.

gs1:energyFromFatPerNutrientBasis.label: Energy from Fat Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:energyFromFatPerNutrientBasis.description: Energy from Fat per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:energyPerNutrientBasis.label: Energy Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:energyPerNutrientBasis.description: Energy Per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:epcis.label: EPC Information Services (EPCIS) repository
gs1:epcis.description: A link to an EPCIS repository of visibility event data.

gs1:epcisRepository.label: EPC Information Services (EPCIS) repository
gs1:epcisRepository.description: A link to an EPCIS repository of visibility event data.

gs1:epil.label: Electronic Patient Information Leaflet
gs1:epil.description: A link to an electronic patient information leaflet.

gs1:equivalentProduct.label: Has Equivalent Product
gs1:equivalentProduct.description: A product which can be substituted for the product based on supplier-defined functional equivalence to the product.

gs1:eventsInfo.label: Events information
gs1:eventsInfo.description: A link to event details. For a page specifically for scheduling a reservation or booking an appointment, see gs1:scheduleTime.

gs1:exactDiscountAmount.label: Exact Discount Amount
gs1:exactDiscountAmount.description: Links to a gs1:PriceSpecification that indicates in terms of an amount and specified currency, the exact discount on the sales price associated with a particular gs1:Discount. This property can be used to express '$10 off'.

gs1:exactDiscountPercentage.label: Exact Discount Percentage
gs1:exactDiscountPercentage.description: A floating-point value indicating an exact percentage discount on the sales price associated with a particular gs1:Discount. This property can be used to express '15% discount'.

gs1:exclusionDescription.label: Exclusion Description
gs1:exclusionDescription.description: A text description of any products, brands, or categories that cannot be used with the offer

gs1:expirationDate.label: Expiration Date
gs1:expirationDate.description: The expiration date is the date that determines the limit of consumption or use of a product/coupon. Its meaning is determined based on the trade item context (e.g., for food, the date will indicate the possibility of a direct health risk resulting from use of the product after the date, for pharmaceutical products, it will indicate the possibility of an indirect health risk resulting from the ineffectiveness of the product after the date). It is often referred to as 'use by date' or 'maximum durability date'.

gs1:expirationDateTime.label: Expiration Date and Time
gs1:expirationDateTime.description: The manufacturer determines the expiration date and time, which is relevant only for short duration and for items that will not be sent on long distances and not outside of the time zone. A typical application of AI (7003) is in hospitals or public pharmacies for special, customised, products which may have a 'life duration' shorter than one single day. The life duration varies according the pharmaceutical substances used in the treatment. The precise expiration date and time is defined at the end of the manufacturing process, and can be barcoded on the product label as an attribute to the item's GTIN. Where there is no business requirement to express the expiration date to the nearest hour (or less), AI (17) Expiration date should be used.

gs1:faqs.label: Frequently Asked Questions
gs1:faqs.description: A link to a set of frequently asked questions.

gs1:fatInMilkContent.label: Fat In Milk Content
gs1:fatInMilkContent.description: The percentage of fat contained in milk content of the product.

gs1:fatPerNutrientBasis.label: Fat Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:fatPerNutrientBasis.description: Fat per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:fatpercentageInDryMatter.label: Fat In Dry Matter
gs1:fatpercentageInDryMatter.description: The amount of fat contained in the base product expressed in percentage.

gs1:faxNumber.label: Telefax
gs1:faxNumber.description: A fax number used for transmitting and reproducing fixed graphic material over telephone lines or other electronic transmission media.

gs1:fibrePerNutrientBasis.label: Fibre Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:fibrePerNutrientBasis.description: Fibre per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:fileLanguageCode.label: File Language Code
gs1:fileLanguageCode.description: The specified language to which the digital asset is targeted. It is recommended to use the ISO 639-1 language code.

gs1:filePixelHeight.label: File Pixel Height
gs1:filePixelHeight.description: The number of pixels along the vertical axis of the image.

gs1:filePixelWidth.label: File Pixel Width
gs1:filePixelWidth.description: The number of pixels along the horizontal axis of the image.

gs1:firstFreezeDate.label: First Freeze Date
gs1:firstFreezeDate.description: The first freeze date is applicable to products that are frozen directly after slaughtering, harvesting, catching or after initial processing of the product. Examples include fresh meat, meat products or fishery products. The first freeze date is determined by the organisation conducting the freezing.

gs1:fishType.label: Fish Type
gs1:fishType.description: The type of fish for example Sea bass.

gs1:fluoridePerNutrientBasis.label: Fluoride Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:fluoridePerNutrientBasis.description: Fluoride per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:folicAcidPerNutrientBasis.label: Folic Acid Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:folicAcidPerNutrientBasis.description: Folic Acid per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:foodBeverageRefrigerationClaim.label: Food Beverage Refrigeration Claim
gs1:foodBeverageRefrigerationClaim.description: Identifies whether or not the product requires refrigeration.

gs1:foodBeverageTargetUse.label: Food Beverage Target Use
gs1:foodBeverageTargetUse.description: The type of meal the food or beverage product is targeted to for example Breakfast.

gs1:footwearFasteningType.label: Fastening Type
gs1:footwearFasteningType.description: Something that mechanically joins or affixes two or more parts together in a footwear product for example a shoe lace.

gs1:footwearUpperType.label: Footwear Upper Type
gs1:footwearUpperType.description: The descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify whether the footwear upper is open or closed. Otherwise known as Open or Closed Upper.

gs1:franchiseeOf.label: Franchisee of
gs1:franchiseeOf.description: Method for associating the franchisor organisation to the franchisee.

gs1:franchisorOf.label: Franchisor of
gs1:franchisorOf.description: Method for associating franchisee organisation(s) to the franchisor.

gs1:freshOrSeawaterFarmed.label: Fresh or Seawater Farmed
gs1:freshOrSeawaterFarmed.description: A code determining whether the fish originated from the sea or was farmed.

gs1:functionalName.label: Functional Name
gs1:functionalName.description: Describes use of the product or service by the consumer. Should help clarify the product classification associated with the GTIN.

gs1:geneticallyModifiedDeclaration.label: Genetically Modified Declaration Code
gs1:geneticallyModifiedDeclaration.description: A statement of the presence or absence of genetically modified protein or DNA.

gs1:geo.label: Has Geocoordinates
gs1:geo.description: Links to information about geocoordinates or geoshapes for a place.

gs1:glnType.label: Has GLN Type
gs1:glnType.description: Indicates what type of thing is being identified by a GLN.

gs1:globalLocationNumber.label: Global Location Number (GLN)
gs1:globalLocationNumber.description: A Global Location Number (GLN) is the GS1 Identification Key used to identify physical locations or parties. The key comprises a GS1 Company Prefix, Location Reference and Check Digit. For more information see https://www.gs1.org/gln.

gs1:gpcCategoryCode.label: GPC Category Code
gs1:gpcCategoryCode.description: 8-digit code (GPC Brick Value) specifying a product category according to the GS1 Global Product Classification (GPC) standard. For more information see https://www.gs1.org/gpc

gs1:gpcCategoryDescription.label: GPC Category Description
gs1:gpcCategoryDescription.description: A description of the code specifying a product category according to the GS1 Global Product Classification (GPC) standard.

gs1:grossArea.label: Gross area
gs1:grossArea.description: The overall area of the item including packaging. This can be given using a number of different AI ranges that depend on the units in which the area is measured.

gs1:grossVolume.label: Gross volume
gs1:grossVolume.description: The overall volume of the item including packaging. This can be given using a number of different AI ranges that depend on the units in which the volume is measured.

gs1:grossWeight.label: Gross Weight
gs1:grossWeight.description: Used to identify the gross weight of the product. The gross weight includes all packaging materials of the product. At pallet level the productGrossWeight includes the weight of the pallet itself. For example, 200 GRM, value - total pounds, total grams, etc.

gs1:growingMethod.label: Growing Method
gs1:growingMethod.description: The process through which fresh produce is grown and cultivated.

gs1:gtin.label: GTIN
gs1:gtin.description: A Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) is the 14 digit GS1 Identification Key used to identify products. The key comprises a GS1 Company Prefix followed by an Item Reference Number and a Check Digit. See https://www.gs1.org/gtin for more details.

gs1:handledBy.label: Handled by
gs1:handledBy.description: Used when one resolver redirects all request URIs that match a given pattern without further processing, such as from GS1 to a brand-operated service. See section 7.7.1 of the Digital Link standard, version 1.1.

gs1:harvestDate.label: Harvest Date.
gs1:harvestDate.description: The harvest date. For example, the harvest date can be the date when an animal was slaughtered or killed, a fish has been harvested, or a crop was harvested. This date is determined by the organisation conducting the harvesting. Different organisations may use more specific terminology when referring to their specific needs and use terms such as: Date of catch or slaughter date.

gs1:harvestDateEnd.label: Harvest Date End
gs1:harvestDateEnd.description: The harvest end date. For example, the harvest end date can be the date when an animal was slaughtered or killed, a fish has been harvested, or a crop was harvested. This end date is determined by the organisation conducting the harvesting. Different organisations may use more specific terminology when referring to their specific needs and use terms such as: Date of catch or slaughter date. When referring to animals the date range refers to the whole animal and all meat or fish cuts derived from this animal.

gs1:harvestDateStart.label: Harvest Date Start
gs1:harvestDateStart.description: The harvest start date. For example, the harvest start date can be the date when an animal was slaughtered or killed, a fish has been harvested, or a crop was harvested. This start date is determined by the organisation conducting the harvesting. Different organisations may use more specific terminology when referring to their specific needs and use terms such as: Date of catch or slaughter date. When referring to animals the date range refers to the whole animal and all meat or fish cuts derived from this animal.

gs1:hasBatchLotNumber.label: Batch/Lot Identifier
gs1:hasBatchLotNumber.description: The batch or lot number associates an item with information the manufacturer considers relevant for traceability of the trade item to which the element string is applied. The data may refer to the trade item itself or to items contained. The number may be, for example, a production lot number, a shift number, a machine number, a time, or an internal production code. In cases where the same product is manufactured in different locations the brand owner and the manufacturer are responsible for ensuring the non-duplication of batch/lot numbers for a GTIN. For the re-use of batch/lot numbers with a GTIN, sector-specific constraints need to be considered.

gs1:hasPrimaryLocation.label: Has primary location
gs1:hasPrimaryLocation.description: Links to the place(s) that this organisation designates as their primary location(s).

gs1:hasRetailers.label: Has Retailers
gs1:hasRetailers.description: A link to a list of retailers.

gs1:hasReturnablePackageDeposit.label: Has Returnable Package Deposit Details
gs1:hasReturnablePackageDeposit.description: links to details of amounts refunded for returnable package in a specified region.

gs1:hasSerialNumber.label: Serial Number
gs1:hasSerialNumber.description: A serial number is assigned to an entity for its lifetime. When combined with a GTIN, a serial number uniquely identifies an individual item. The serial number field is alphanumeric and may include all characters contained in figure 7.11-1. The brand owner and the manufacturer are responsible for ensuring the non-duplication of serial numbers for a GTIN. For the re-use of serial numbers with a GTIN, sector-specific constraints need to be considered.

gs1:hasThirdPartyControlledSerialNumber.label: Third-Party Controlled Serial Number
gs1:hasThirdPartyControlledSerialNumber.description: This identifier is assigned to an entity for its lifetime. When combined with a GTIN, a TPX uniquely identifies an individual item and forms a unit pack Unique Identifier (upUI) for tobacco traceability per EU 2018/574. The serial number field is alphanumeric and may include all characters contained in figure 7.11-1. The Third Party determines the TPX, but the TPX shall begin with the ID Issuer Unique Identification Code (UIC), followed by GS1 UIC Extension 1, and GS1 UIC Extension 2.

gs1:healthClaimDescription.label: Health Claim
gs1:healthClaimDescription.description: A description of health claims according to regulations of the target market.

gs1:homepage.label: Organisation Information Page
gs1:homepage.description: A link to general information about an organisation or brand. Typically the homepage of an organisation's website. It may include links to further information such as certifications, careers, payments, reservations, etc.

gs1:image.label: Has Product Image
gs1:image.description: Link to a file containing a visual representation of the product.

gs1:inPackageDepth.label: In Package Depth
gs1:inPackageDepth.description: The depth of the product in its packaging, as measured according to the GS1 Package Measurement Rules. See https://www.gs1.org/package-measurement-rules-implementation-guide for more details.

gs1:inPackageDiameter.label: In Package Diameter
gs1:inPackageDiameter.description: The measurement of the diameter of the product in its package at its largest point. For example, 165 MMT.

gs1:inPackageHeight.label: In Package Height
gs1:inPackageHeight.description: The height of the product in the package, as measured according to the GS1 Package Measurement Rules. See https://www.gs1.org/package-measurement-rules-implementation-guide for more details.

gs1:inPackageWidth.label: In Package Width
gs1:inPackageWidth.description: The width of the product in the package, as measured according to the GS1 Package Measurement Rules. See https://www.gs1.org/package-measurement-rules-implementation-guide for more details.

gs1:includedAccessories.label: Included Accessories
gs1:includedAccessories.description: Any included object or device not part of the core product itself but which adds to its functionality or use.

gs1:ingredient.label: Has Food And Beverage Ingredient Information
gs1:ingredient.description: Links to information about ingredients of a specific Food/Beverage/Tobacco product.

gs1:ingredientContentPercentage.label: Ingredient Content Percentage
gs1:ingredientContentPercentage.description: Quantity of the ingredient contained in the product as a percentage of the total product ingredients. This is used in conjunction with ingredientName.

gs1:ingredientName.label: Ingredient Name
gs1:ingredientName.description: Free text field describing an ingredient or ingredient group. Ingredients include any additives (colourings, preservatives, e-numbers, etc.) that are encompassed.

gs1:ingredientOfConcern.label: Ingredient of Concern
gs1:ingredientOfConcern.description: Indicates a claim to an ingredient, considered to be a concern for regulatory or other reasons, and which is 'contained' within the product but may not need to specify the amount whether approximate, or an accurate measurement be given.

gs1:ingredientSequence.label: Ingredient Sequence
gs1:ingredientSequence.description: Integer (1, 2, 3...) indicating the ingredient order by content percentage of the product. (major ingredient = 1, second ingredient = 2) etc.

gs1:ingredientStatement.label: Ingredient Statement
gs1:ingredientStatement.description: Information on the constituent ingredient make up of the product specified as one string.

gs1:ingredientsInfo.label: Ingredients information
gs1:ingredientsInfo.description: A link to facts about ingredients.

gs1:initialCertificationDate.label: Initial Certification Date
gs1:initialCertificationDate.description: The date when the certification was originally issued. May differ from the certificationStartDate of the current recertification cycle.

gs1:instructions.label: Instructions
gs1:instructions.description: A link to instructions, such as assembly instructions, usage tips etc. It is not appropriate to use this link type for healthcare regulated content applications for which specific link types are available.

gs1:instructionsForUse.label: Has Instructions For Use
gs1:instructionsForUse.description: Link to a file containing the Instructions For Use.

gs1:iodinePerNutrientBasis.label: Iodine Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:iodinePerNutrientBasis.description: Iodine per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:ironPerNutrientBasis.label: Iron Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:ironPerNutrientBasis.description: Iron per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:irradiatedCode.label: Irradiated Code
gs1:irradiatedCode.description: Indicates if radiation has been applied to the product.

gs1:isCarbonated.label: Is Carbonated
gs1:isCarbonated.description: Used to identify whether or not a beverage product is naturally effervescent or has been made effervescent by the addition of carbon dioxide gas.

gs1:isDecaffeinated.label: Is Decaffeinated
gs1:isDecaffeinated.description: The descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify whether or not the product contains caffeine.

gs1:isFromConcentrate.label: Is From Concentrate
gs1:isFromConcentrate.description: Used to identify whether or not the product claims to be made from a concentrated formulation.

gs1:isHomogenised.label: Is Homogenised
gs1:isHomogenised.description: A The indication whether or not the milk used was actively homogenised. The homogenisation of milk is a technical process in the dairy. The milk fat is milled to such an extent that further creaming is prevented.

gs1:isInstant.label: Is Instant
gs1:isInstant.description: Determines whether the product is instant.

gs1:isMaternity.label: Is Maternity
gs1:isMaternity.description: Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify if the product is intended as maternity wear.

gs1:isOnlyAvailableThroughRetailer.label: Only Available Through Retailer
gs1:isOnlyAvailableThroughRetailer.description: If specified and set to true, the discount is only available through the retailer making the offer.

gs1:isOnlyWithMailingListSignup.label: Only For Retailer Mailing List Members
gs1:isOnlyWithMailingListSignup.description: If specified and set to true, the discount is only available for customers who have signed up to the retailer's mailing list.

gs1:isOnlyWithPaymentCard.label: Only With Payment Card
gs1:isOnlyWithPaymentCard.description: If specified, the discount is only available when purchasing using one of the specified payment card types.

gs1:isOnlyWithRetailerLoyaltyCard.label: Only For Retailer Loyalty Cardholders
gs1:isOnlyWithRetailerLoyaltyCard.description: If specified and set to true, the discount is only available for holders of the retailer's own loyalty card.

gs1:isOnlyWithRetailerPaymentCard.label: Only For Retailer Payment Cardholders
gs1:isOnlyWithRetailerPaymentCard.description: If specified and set to true, the discount is only available for holders of the retailer's own store payment card.

gs1:isPatterned.label: Is Patterned
gs1:isPatterned.description: The descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify whether or not the product has a patterned design.

gs1:isPittedStoned.label: Is Pitted Stoned
gs1:isPittedStoned.description: The descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify whether or not a fruit or vegetable product has been de-stoned or pitted prior to being offered for sale.

gs1:isProductRecalled.label: Is Product Recalled
gs1:isProductRecalled.description: An indicator for the product to determine if the Manufacturer or Supplier has recalled the product.

gs1:isPromoterExclusiveOffer.label: Is Promoter Exclusive Offer
gs1:isPromoterExclusiveOffer.description: Determines whether the offer is only provided by the promoter

gs1:isRindEdible.label: Is Rind Edible
gs1:isRindEdible.description: An indicator whether or not the cheese rind is edible. Some cheeses are coated in plastic or their surface is treated with other traditional substances to increase their shelf life. This can result in the rind no longer being edible.

gs1:isSeedless.label: Is Seedless
gs1:isSeedless.description: Determines whether the product is seedless as grown.

gs1:isShelledPeeled.label: Is Shelled or Peeled
gs1:isShelledPeeled.description: The descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify whether or not the product or its contents have been shelled/peeled prior to being offered for sale.

gs1:isSliced.label: Is Sliced
gs1:isSliced.description: Determines whether the product comes pre-sliced.

gs1:isThermal.label: Is Thermal
gs1:isThermal.description: The descriptive term that is used to identify whether the product is thermal.

gs1:isVintage.label: Is Vintage
gs1:isVintage.description: Identifies whether the product makes claim to being vintage.

gs1:isWashedReadyToEat.label: Is Washed Ready To Eat
gs1:isWashedReadyToEat.description: Determines whether product has been prewashed and is ready to eat.

gs1:isWaterproof.label: Is Waterproof
gs1:isWaterproof.description: The descriptive term that is used to identify whether or not the product claims to provide waterproofing to the applied surface.

gs1:isWearableItemDisposable.label: Is Wearable Item Disposable
gs1:isWearableItemDisposable.description: Identifies whether or not the product is intended to be disposed of after single use or a limited period of use.

gs1:itemOffered.label: Item Offered
gs1:itemOffered.description: The product included in the offer.

gs1:juiceContentPercent.label: Juice Content Percent
gs1:juiceContentPercent.description: The fruit juice content of the product expressed as a percentage.

gs1:jws.label: JSON Web Signature
gs1:jws.description: A link to a JSON Web Signature

gs1:latitude.label: Latitude
gs1:latitude.description: Angular distance North or South from the earth's equator measured through 90 degrees.

gs1:leasedFrom.label: Leased from
gs1:leasedFrom.description: Links to the organisation (lessor) from which this place is leased.

gs1:leasedTo.label: Leased to
gs1:leasedTo.description: Links to the organisation(s) (lessee(s)) to which this place is leased. Property SHOULD be applied to a specific sub-location, rather than a main location, wherever possible.

gs1:leaveReview.label: Leave a review
gs1:leaveReview.description: A link through which a review can be added.

gs1:lesseeOf.label: Lessee of location
gs1:lesseeOf.description: Links to the place(s) for which this organisation is the lessee (i.e., this organisation leases those places from another organisation, the lessor).

gs1:lessorFor.label: Lessor for
gs1:lessorFor.description: Links to the place(s) for which this organisation is the lessor (i.e., this organisation leases those places to others).

gs1:line.label: Line
gs1:line.description: A line is a point-to-point path consisting of two or more point objects separated by a space. A single line segment (i.e., straight line) is expressed as two points. A multi-line path (i.e., open polygon) is expressed as a series of three or more points. For a closed shape, gs1:polygon SHALL be used.

gs1:linkType.label: Link Type
gs1:linkType.description: Provides a URL for related information or services. This is not expected to be used directly but provides a super property for all other link types in the GS1 ecosystem.

gs1:location.label: Has Location
gs1:location.description: The place(s) associated with an organization.

gs1:locationFinalClosureDate.label: Location Final Closure Date
gs1:locationFinalClosureDate.description: Date in which a location was finally closed. Note that this is NOT the date when a GLN was deactivated. To designate when location opened, see gs1:locationOpeningDate.

gs1:locationGLN.label: Location GLN
gs1:locationGLN.description: 13-digit GLN that is being used to identify a physical or digital location. If gs1:glnType is present, gs1:locationGLN SHALL only be used when gs1:GLN_TypeCode includes FIXED_PHYSICAL_LOCATION, MOBILE_PHYSICAL_LOCATION, or DIGITAL_LOCATION

gs1:locationHistory.label: Has Location History
gs1:locationHistory.description: Provides details on if and when a location is active or inactive.

gs1:locationID.label: Location ID
gs1:locationID.description: Identifier value associated to a location. This value SHALL follow rules set forth by the administrating organisation designated in gs1:LocationID_Type.

gs1:locationID_Qualifier.label: Location ID Qualifier
gs1:locationID_Qualifier.description: Secondary qualifier to supplement gs1:LocationID_Type meaning. May be used with proprietary ID code values to define identifier administrator.

gs1:locationID_Type.label: Location ID
gs1:locationID_Type.description: Organisation that administers the gs1:locationID or the name of the ID itself. Value from gs1:LocationID_Type code list.

gs1:locationID_URI.label: Location ID URI
gs1:locationID_URI.description: A URI that links to information about the gs1:locationID.

gs1:locationInfo.label: Location information
gs1:locationInfo.description: A link to a map, directions, or other location-related information. For B2B location information, see gs1:logisticsInfo. For details specific to hours of operation, see gs1:openingHoursInfo

gs1:locationOpeningDate.label: Location Opening Date
gs1:locationOpeningDate.description: Date in which a location was opened or otherwise established. Note that this is NOT the date when a GLN was allocated to identify the location. To designate when location was finally closed, see gs1: gs1:locationFinalClosureDate

gs1:locationRole.label: Location Role
gs1:locationRole.description: A location classification based on the purpose, type of site and/or what occurs there. Repeatable value from gs1:LocationRoleType code list.

gs1:locationStatus.label: Location Status
gs1:locationStatus.description: Designation of active/inactive status of a location.

gs1:logisticsInfo.label: Logistics information
gs1:logisticsInfo.description: A link to B2B logistics information related to a physical location.

gs1:longitude.label: Longitude
gs1:longitude.description: The arc or portion of the earth's equator intersected between the meridian of a given place and the prime meridian and expressed in degrees

gs1:loyaltyProgram.label: Loyalty program
gs1:loyaltyProgram.description: A link to information about a loyalty program, including a member's current status and/or a registration option for new members

gs1:magnesiumPerNutrientBasis.label: Magnesium Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:magnesiumPerNutrientBasis.description: Magnesium per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:makesOffer.label: Makes Offer
gs1:makesOffer.description: An offer made by an organization.

gs1:managedBy.label: Managed by
gs1:managedBy.description: Links to the organisation that manages this place or organisation, as designated by the owner or another organisation.

gs1:managedFor.label: Managed for
gs1:managedFor.description: Links to the organisation(s) for whom this place is managed. Property SHOULD be applied to a specific sub-location, rather than a main location, wherever possible.

gs1:manages.label: Manages
gs1:manages.description: Links to the place(s) or organisation(s) that this organisation manages, on behalf of the owner or another organisation.

gs1:manganesePerNutrientBasis.label: Manganese Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:manganesePerNutrientBasis.description: Manganese per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:manufacturer.label: Has Manufacturer
gs1:manufacturer.description: The organization that produces the item.

gs1:manufacturerPreparationCode.label: Manufacturer Preparation Code
gs1:manufacturerPreparationCode.description: Code indicating the preparation methods that a manufacturer has used in the manufacturing of a product for example DEEP_FRY.

gs1:manufacturersWarranty.label: Has Manufacturer's Warranty
gs1:manufacturersWarranty.description: The warranty associated with the product.

gs1:manufacturingPlant.label: Has Manufacturing Plant
gs1:manufacturingPlant.description: A physical location consisting of one or more buildings with facilities for manufacturing.

gs1:massPerUnitArea.label: Mass per unit area
gs1:massPerUnitArea.description: The mass per unit area of the item. This can be given using a number of different AI ranges that depend on the units in which the mass and area are measured.

gs1:masterData.label: Master data
gs1:masterData.description: A link to a source of structured master data for the entity. This is typically for B2B applications.

gs1:masterDataAvailableFor.label: Master Data Available For
gs1:masterDataAvailableFor.description: Links from a document, message or event to static data for specified identifiers.

gs1:maturationMethod.label: Maturation Method Code
gs1:maturationMethod.description: The method of maturity for the item for example tree ripened or jet fresh.

gs1:maxPrice.label: Maximum Price
gs1:maxPrice.description: Provides a maximum price value as a floating-point numeric value that is qualified by the corresponding currency. See also gs1:priceCurrency

gs1:maximumDiscountAmount.label: Maximum Discount Amount
gs1:maximumDiscountAmount.description: Links to a gs1:PriceSpecification that indicates in terms of an amount and specified currency, the maximum discount on the sales price associated with a particular gs1:Discount. This property can be used to express 'up to $10 off'.

gs1:maximumDiscountPercentage.label: Maximum Discount Percentage
gs1:maximumDiscountPercentage.description: A floating-point value indicating a maximum percentage discount on the sales price associated with a particular gs1:Discount. This property can be used to express 'up to 15% discount'.

gs1:maximumOptimumConsumptionTemperature.label: Maximum Optimum Consumption Temperature
gs1:maximumOptimumConsumptionTemperature.description: The upper limit drinking temperature of the optimum range of the drinking temperature. The optimum range of the drinking temperature is a recommendation and is based on the experience of the individual producer. Allows for the representation of the same value in different units of measure but not multiple values.

gs1:maximumQualifyingItems.label: Maximum Qualifying Items
gs1:maximumQualifyingItems.description: Specifies the maximum number of items that qualify for a particular gs1:Discount. This property can be used to express 'maximum N items per customer'.

gs1:maximumQualifyingSpend.label: Maximum Qualifying Spend
gs1:maximumQualifyingSpend.description: Links to a gs1:PriceSpecification that indicates in terms of an amount and specified currency, the maximum spend that qualifies for a particular gs1:Discount. This property can be used to express 'for purchases of up to $100'.

gs1:meatPoultryType.label: Meat Poultry Type Code
gs1:meatPoultryType.description: The fish, meat, or poultry type for this food and beverage item.

gs1:menuInfo.label: Menu information
gs1:menuInfo.description: A link to menu details. This may include food menus, services, or other offerings provided by an organisation or at a location. For details specific to allergens only, see gs1:allergenInfo . For details specific to nutrition information only, see gs1:nutritionalInfo . For details specific to ingredients only, see gs1:ingredientsInfo .

gs1:messageRecipient.label: Message Sender
gs1:messageRecipient.description: Identifies the party receiving an electronic message

gs1:messageSender.label: Message Sender
gs1:messageSender.description: Identifies the party sending an electronic message

gs1:minPrice.label: Minimum Price
gs1:minPrice.description: Provides a minimum price value as a floating-point numeric value that is qualified by the corresponding currency. See also gs1:priceCurrency

gs1:minimumDiscountAmount.label: Minimum Discount Amount
gs1:minimumDiscountAmount.description: Links to a gs1:PriceSpecification that indicates in terms of an amount and specified currency, the minimum discount on the sales price associated with a particular gs1:Discount. This property can be used to express 'at least $10 off'.

gs1:minimumDiscountPercentage.label: Minimum Discount Percentage
gs1:minimumDiscountPercentage.description: A floating-point value indicating a minimum percentage discount on the sales price associated with a particular gs1:Discount. This property can be used to express 'at least 15% discount'.

gs1:minimumFishContent.label: Minimum Fish Content
gs1:minimumFishContent.description: The minimum amount of fish contained in a food and beverage product expressed as a measurement.

gs1:minimumMeatPoultryContent.label: Minimum Meat Poultry Content
