gs1:minimumMeatPoultryContent.description: The minimum amount of fish, meat or poultry contained in a food and beverage product expressed as a measurement.

gs1:minimumOptimumConsumptionTemperature.label: Minimum Optimum Consumption Temperature
gs1:minimumOptimumConsumptionTemperature.description: The lower limit drinking temperature of the optimum range of the drinking temperature. The optimum range of the drinking temperature is a recommendation and is based on the experience of the individual producer. Allows for the representation of the same value in different units of measure but not multiple values.

gs1:minimumQualifyingItems.label: Minimum Qualifying Items
gs1:minimumQualifyingItems.description: Specifies the minimum number of items that must be purchased to qualify for a particular gs1:Discount. This property can be used to express 'if you buy at least N items'.

gs1:minimumQualifyingSpend.label: Minimum Qualifying Spend
gs1:minimumQualifyingSpend.description: Links to a gs1:PriceSpecification that indicates in terms of an amount and specified currency, the minimum spend required to qualify for a particular gs1:Discount. This property can be used to express 'if you spend at least $100'.

gs1:molybdenumPerNutrientBasis.label: Molybdenum Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:molybdenumPerNutrientBasis.description: Molybdenum per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:monounsaturatedFatPerNutrientBasis.label: Monounsaturated Fat Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:monounsaturatedFatPerNutrientBasis.description: Monounsaturated fat per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:netArea.label: Net area
gs1:netArea.description: The net area of the item. This can be given using a number of different AI ranges that depend on the units in which the area is measured.

gs1:netContent.label: Net content
gs1:netContent.description: The quantity of the product contained by a package, usually as claimed on the label. Indicates the net content of the total product. For fixed value products use the value claimed on the package, to avoid variable fill rate issue that arises with some product which are sold by volume or weight, and whose actual content may vary slightly from batch to batch.

gs1:netWeight.label: Net weight
gs1:netWeight.description: Used to identify the net weight of the product. Net Weight excludes all packaging material, including the packaging material of all lower-level GTINs. Example:11.5 kgm.

gs1:niacinPerNutrientBasis.label: Niacin Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:niacinPerNutrientBasis.description: Niacin per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:numberOfServingsPerPackage.label: Number of Servings Per Package
gs1:numberOfServingsPerPackage.description: The total number of servings contained in the package.

gs1:numberOfServingsPerPackageMeasuremen.label: Number of Servings Per Package Measurement Precision
gs1:numberOfServingsPerPackageMeasuremen.description: Code indicating whether the number of servings per package is exact or approximate.

gs1:numberOfServingsRangeDescription.label: Number of Servings Range Description
gs1:numberOfServingsRangeDescription.description: A free text field specifying a range for the number of servings contained in the package.

gs1:nutrientBasisQuantity.label: Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:nutrientBasisQuantity.description: Quantity on which the nutrient information has been based; for example, per 100 grams. When specified, nutrientBasisQuantity establishes the basis for all contained nutrient records.

gs1:nutrientBasisQuantityType.label: Nutrient Basis Quantity Type Code
gs1:nutrientBasisQuantityType.description: The type of quantity specified in the nutrientBasisQuantity for example measurement, serving size, or container. This is used in conjunction with the nutrientBasisQuantity.

gs1:nutrientMeasurementPrecision.label: Nutrient Measurement Precision
gs1:nutrientMeasurementPrecision.description: The Code indicating whether the specified nutrient content is exact or approximate.

gs1:nutritionalClaim.label: Nutritional Claim Code
gs1:nutritionalClaim.description: Code indicating a nutritional claim applicable to the product, for example FAT_FREE.

gs1:nutritionalClaimStatement.label: Nutritional Claim Statement
gs1:nutritionalClaimStatement.description: Free text field for any additional nutritional claims.

gs1:occupiedBy.label: Occupied by
gs1:occupiedBy.description: Links to the organisation(s) that occupy this place. Property SHOULD be applied to a specific sub-location, rather than a main location, wherever possible.

gs1:occupies.label: Occupies location
gs1:occupies.description: Links to the place(s) that this organisation occupies.

gs1:offerDescription.label: Offer Description
gs1:offerDescription.description: A description of the offer including goods or services offered for sale or use.

gs1:offerDiscount.label: Offer Discount
gs1:offerDiscount.description: A discount associated with an offer.

gs1:offerRedemptionType.label: Offer Redemption Type
gs1:offerRedemptionType.description: A code indicating the type of redemptions that apply to the offer, for example single use.

gs1:offerRedemptionURL.label: Offer Redemption URL
gs1:offerRedemptionURL.description: The URL where the offer seeker will need to go in order to redeem the offer for an online redemption.

gs1:offerRestrictionDescription.label: Offer Restriction Description
gs1:offerRestrictionDescription.description: A description of what the offer is restricted to, relative to all other offerings by the issuer, for example payment restrictions, subscription required, new customers only.

gs1:openingHoursInfo.label: Opening hours information
gs1:openingHoursInfo.description: A link to details on hours of operation.

gs1:organicClaim.label: Has Organic Claim
gs1:organicClaim.description: Relates to an organic claim about the product

gs1:organicClaimAgency.label: Organic Claim Agency Code
gs1:organicClaimAgency.description: A governing body that creates and maintains standards related to organic products.

gs1:organicPercentClaim.label: Organic Percent Claim
gs1:organicPercentClaim.description: The percent of actual organic materials per weight of the product. This is usually claimed on the product.

gs1:organizationClassification.label: Has Organization Classification
gs1:organizationClassification.description: Links to one or more instances of gs1:OrganizationClassificationDetails for expresing the classification of the economic activities of an organisation.

gs1:organizationClassificationType.label: Organization Classification Type
gs1:organizationClassificationType.description: Classification system name associated with gs1:organizationClassificationID.

gs1:organizationClassificationID.label: Organization Classification ID
gs1:organizationClassificationID.description: Classification value that is administered by an organisation. This value SHALL follow rules set forth by the system indicated by the code value of gs1:organizationClassificationType.

gs1:organizationFormationDate.label: Organisation Formation Date
gs1:organizationFormationDate.description: Date in which an organisation was formed or otherwise established. Note that this is NOT the date when a GLN was allocated to identify the organisation. To designate when organisation was terminated, see gs1:organizationTerminationDate

gs1:organizationHistory.label: Has Organization History
gs1:organizationHistory.description: Provides details on if and when an organisation/party is active or inactive.

gs1:organizationID.label: Organisation ID
gs1:organizationID.description: Identifier value associated to an organisation/party. This value SHALL follow rules set forth by the administrating organisation designated in gs1:OrganizationID_Type.

gs1:organizationID_Qualifier.label: Organisation ID Qualifier
gs1:organizationID_Qualifier.description: Secondary qualifier to supplement gs1:organizationID_Type meaning. May be used with proprietary ID code values to define identifier administrator.

gs1:organizationID_Type.label: Organisation ID
gs1:organizationID_Type.description: Organisation that administers the gs1:organizationID or the name of the ID itself. Value from gs1:OrganizationID_Type code list.

gs1:organizationID_URI.label: Organisation ID URI
gs1:organizationID_URI.description: A URI that links to information about the gs1:organizationID.

gs1:organizationLegalName.label: Organization Legal Name
gs1:organizationLegalName.description: The legal name used by an organisation for official purposes. There may be more than one legal name, particularly in countries with more than one official language. In such cases the language of the string should be identified. To specify a general name, see gs1:organizationName. For trade name, see gs1:organizationTradingName. To specify the name of a function, see gs1:department.

gs1:organizationName.label: Organization Name
gs1:organizationName.description: The name of the organization expressed in text.

gs1:organizationRole.label: Has Organization Role
gs1:organizationRole.description: The role and/or purpose of a party (i.e. legal entity or function). Multiple values from gs1:OrganizationRoleType code list may be associated to a single organisation/party.

gs1:organizationStatus.label: Organisation Status
gs1:organizationStatus.description: Designation of active/inactive status of an organisation/party.

gs1:organizationTerminationDate.label: Organisation Termination Date
gs1:organizationTerminationDate.description: Date in which an organisation was disbanded or otherwise ended. Note that this is NOT the date when a GLN was deactivated. To designate when organisation formed, see gs1:organizationFormationDate.

gs1:organizationTradingName.label: Organization Trading Name
gs1:organizationTradingName.description: A trading name or alternative forms of a legal entity's name as recognised by some jurisdictions. To specify a general name, see gs1:organizationName. For legal name, see gs1:organizationLegalName. To specify the name of a function, see gs1:department.

gs1:originalCodeValue.label: Original Code Value
gs1:originalCodeValue.description: Links to the alphanumeric code value defined elsewhere in GS1 or the GS1 Global Data Dictionary

gs1:outOfPackageDepth.label: Out of Package Depth
gs1:outOfPackageDepth.description: The depth of the product out of its packaging, as measured according to the GS1 Package Measurement Rules. See https://www.gs1.org/package-measurement-rules-implementation-guide for more details.

gs1:outOfPackageDiameter.label: Out of Package Diameter
gs1:outOfPackageDiameter.description: The measurement of the diameter of the product out of its package at its largest point. For example, 165 MMT.

gs1:outOfPackageHeight.label: Out of Package Height
gs1:outOfPackageHeight.description: The height of the product out of the package, as measured according to the GS1 Package Measurement Rules. See https://www.gs1.org/package-measurement-rules-implementation-guide for more details.

gs1:outOfPackageWidth.label: Out of Package Width
gs1:outOfPackageWidth.description: The width of the product out of the package, as measured according to the GS1 Package Measurement Rules. See https://www.gs1.org/package-measurement-rules-implementation-guide for more details.

gs1:ownedBy.label: Owned by
gs1:ownedBy.description: Links to the organisation(s) that own this place, in full or in part. This includes joint ventures. For leased locations, see gs1:lessorFor and gs1:isLeasedFrom.

gs1:owns.label: Owns
gs1:owns.description: Links to the place(s) or organisation(s) that this organisation owns.

gs1:packaging.label: Has Packaging
gs1:packaging.description: Details on the packaging for a product including type, weight and materials.

gs1:packagingDate.label: Packaging Date
gs1:packagingDate.description: The packaging date is the date when the goods were packed as determined by the packager. The date may refer to the trade item itself or to items contained.

gs1:packagingFeature.label: Packaging Feature
gs1:packagingFeature.description: Code indicating a feature that facilitates the usage of the product by the consumer, for example a handle. Packaging features do not affect the core composition of the packaging type nor modify its usage.

gs1:packagingFunction.label: Packaging Function
gs1:packagingFunction.description: Code indicating specific functionality for packaging resulting from specific processes or features present in the packaging type,for example, ANTI_TAMPERING.

gs1:packagingMarkedDietAllergenType.label: Packaging Marked Diet Allergen Type Code
gs1:packagingMarkedDietAllergenType.description: Indication of which dietary or allergen marks are on the package.

gs1:packagingMarkedFreeFrom.label: Packaging Marked Free From Code
gs1:packagingMarkedFreeFrom.description: Indication of the food ingredients that the package is marked free from.

gs1:packagingMarkedLabelAccreditation.label: Accreditation Code
gs1:packagingMarkedLabelAccreditation.description: A marking that the product received recognition, endorsement, certification by following guidelines by the label issuing agency. This does not represent claims for regulatory purposes on products such as free from markings.

gs1:packagingMaterial.label: Has Packaging Material Details
gs1:packagingMaterial.description: links to details about packaging material type, quantity and thickness

gs1:packagingMaterialCompositionQuantity.label: Packaging Material Composition Quantity
gs1:packagingMaterialCompositionQuantity.description: The quantity of the packaging material of the product. Can be weight, volume or surface, can vary by country.

gs1:packagingMaterialThickness.label: Packaging Material Thickness
gs1:packagingMaterialThickness.description: The thickness of a packaging material.

gs1:packagingMaterialType.label: Packaging Material Type
gs1:packagingMaterialType.description: The materials used for the packaging of the product for example glass or plastic.

gs1:packagingRecyclingProcessType.label: Packaging Recycling Process Type
gs1:packagingRecyclingProcessType.description: The process the packaging could undertake for recyclable & sustainability programs. Examples COMPOSTABLE, ENERGY_RECOVERABLE, REUSABLE.

gs1:packagingRecyclingScheme.label: Packaging Recycling Scheme
gs1:packagingRecyclingScheme.description: A code indicating the recycling scheme the packaging of this product will fall within when recycled. Applies to recyclable packaging with or without deposit.

gs1:packagingShape.label: Packaging Shape
gs1:packagingShape.description: A code depicting the shape of a package for example CONE.

gs1:packagingType.label: Packaging Type
gs1:packagingType.description: The dominant means used to transport, store, handle or display the product as defined by the data source. This packaging is not used to describe any manufacturing process.Recommend to use UNECE Rec 21 codes.

gs1:pantothenicAcidPerNutrientBasis.label: Pantothenic Acid Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:pantothenicAcidPerNutrientBasis.description: Pantothenic Acid per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:parentOrganization.label: Parent Organization
gs1:parentOrganization.description: Designates the legal entity or function directly above the organisation/party being identified in a hierarchy. This is not defaulted to the highest-level entity in the hierarchy. Only one parent organisation SHALL be associated to a single GLN. To specify other affiliated organisations, see gs1:affiliatedTo, gs1:managedBy, gs1:franchiseeOf, gs1:ownedBy. To specify an organisation/party lower in the hierarchy, see gs1:subOrganization.

gs1:partyGLN.label: Party GLN
gs1:partyGLN.description: 13-digit GLN that is being used to identify a legal entity or function. If gs1:glnType is present, gs1:partyGLN SHALL only be used when gs1:GLN_TypeCode includes LEGAL_ENTITY and/or FUNCTION

gs1:paymentLink.label: Make Payment
gs1:paymentLink.description: A link to a place where payments details are provided and/or payments can be made by the user.

gs1:paymentTerms.label: Payment Terms
gs1:paymentTerms.description: The type of payment term expressed as a code, for example Discount.

gs1:percentageOfAlcoholByVolume.label: Percentage of Alcohol Per Volume
gs1:percentageOfAlcoholByVolume.description: The percentage of alcohol contained in product.

gs1:phosphorusPerNutrientBasis.label: Phosphorus Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:phosphorusPerNutrientBasis.description: Phosphorus per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:physicalLocationName.label: Physical Location Name
gs1:physicalLocationName.description: The name of a physical place. To specify the name of a digital location, see gs1:digitalLocationName.

gs1:pip.label: Product Information Page
gs1:pip.description: A link to information specifically about the identified item, typically operated by the brand owner or a retailer of the product and aimed at consumers. It may include links to further information, product description, specifications etc.

gs1:polygon.label: Polygon
gs1:polygon.description: A polygon is the area enclosed by a point-to-point path for which the starting and ending points are the same. A polygon is expressed as a series of four or more space delimited points where the first and final points are identical.

gs1:polyolsPerNutrientBasis.label: Polyols Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:polyolsPerNutrientBasis.description: Polyols per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:polyunsaturatedFatPerNutrientBasis.label: Polyunsaturated Fat Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:polyunsaturatedFatPerNutrientBasis.description: Polyunsaturated fat per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:postOfficeBoxNumber.label: PO Box Number
gs1:postOfficeBoxNumber.description: The number that identifies a PO box. A PO box is a box in a post office or other postal service location assigned to an organization where postal items may be kept.

gs1:postalCode.label: Postal Code
gs1:postalCode.description: Text specifying the postal code for an address.

gs1:postalName.label: Postal Name
gs1:postalName.description: The name of the recipient expressed in text. Note that this may be different than gs1:OrganizationName.

gs1:potassiumPerNutrientBasis.label: Potassium Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:potassiumPerNutrientBasis.description: Potassium per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:preparationCode.label: Preparation Type Code
gs1:preparationCode.description: Code specifying the preparation state of the product for which the nutrient information is valid. PREPARED, UNPREPARED.

gs1:preparationConsumptionPrecautions.label: Preparation Consumption Precautions
gs1:preparationConsumptionPrecautions.description: Specifies additional precautions to be taken before preparation or consumption of the product.

gs1:preparationInformation.label: Has Food And Beverage Preparation Information
gs1:preparationInformation.description: Links to information about how to prepare a specific Food/Beverage/Tobacco product.

gs1:preparationInstructions.label: Preparation Instructions
gs1:preparationInstructions.description: Free text providing instructions on how to prepare the product before serving.

gs1:preservationTechnique.label: Preservation Technique
gs1:preservationTechnique.description: Code indicating the preservation technique used to preserve the product from deterioration, for example, BRINING.

gs1:price.label: Price Value
gs1:price.description: Provides a price value as a floating-point numeric value that is qualified by the corresponding currency. See also gs1:priceCurrency. The price value indicates the unit price unless the property gs1:eligibleQuantity is specified and indicates multiple units

gs1:priceCurrency.label: Price Currency
gs1:priceCurrency.description: A string value indicating a currency from ISO 4217 for example USD .

gs1:priceSpecification.label: Price Specification
gs1:priceSpecification.description: The price related to an offer. If the offer is a multi-buy offer for a quantity of product greater than one unit, this should be indicated using the property gs1:eligibleQuantity

gs1:primaryAlternateProduct.label: Has Primary Alternate Product
gs1:primaryAlternateProduct.description: A product that is similar to the current product but is not exact match. Same form fit function, e.g. same product different colour, different package size, better quality.

gs1:primaryLocationOf.label: Primary location of
gs1:primaryLocationOf.description: Links to the organisation(s) that designate this place as its/their primary location. Property SHOULD be applied to a specific sub-location, rather than a main location, wherever possible.

gs1:productDescription.label: Product Description
gs1:productDescription.description: An understandable and useable description of a product using brand and other descriptors. This attribute is filled with as little abbreviation as possible, while keeping to a reasonable length. This should be a meaningful description of the product with full spelling to facilitate message processing. Retailers can use this description as the base to fully understand the brand, flavour, scent etc. of the specific product, in order to accurately create a product description as needed for their internal systems. Examples: XYZ Brand Base Invisible Solid Deodorant AP Stick Spring Breeze.

gs1:productFeatureBenefit.label: Product Feature Benefit
gs1:productFeatureBenefit.description: Element for consumer facing marketing content to describe the key features or benefits of the style suitable for display purposes.

gs1:productFormDescription.label: Product Form Description
gs1:productFormDescription.description: The physical form or shape of the product. Used, for example, in pharmaceutical industry to indicate the formulation of the product. Defines the form the product takes and is distinct from the form of the packaging.

gs1:productID.label: Product ID
gs1:productID.description: Additional means to the Global Trade Item Number to identify a product.

gs1:productMarketingMessage.label: Product Marketing Message
gs1:productMarketingMessage.description: Marketing message associated with the product. Consumer-friendly marketing detailed description of the product.

gs1:productName.label: Product Name
gs1:productName.description: Consumer friendly short description of the product suitable for compact presentation.

gs1:productRange.label: Product Range
gs1:productRange.description: A name, used by a Brand Owner, that span multiple consumer categories or uses. E.g. (Waist Watchers).

gs1:productSustainabilityInfo.label: Sustainability and recycling (deprecated)
gs1:productSustainabilityInfo.description: This term has been deprecated. Please use gs1:sustainabilityInfo instead.

gs1:productYield.label: Product Yield
gs1:productYield.description: Product quantity after preparation. This can differ based on productYieldType

gs1:productYieldType.label: Product Yield Type Code
gs1:productYieldType.description: Code indicating the type of yield measurement specified in productYield. Examples: AFTER_DILUTION, DRAINED_WEIGHT.

gs1:productYieldVariationPercentage.label: Product Yield Variation Percentage
gs1:productYieldVariationPercentage.description: Indication of range in percent of the given cooking / roasting loss. Percentage that the actual weight of the product differs upward or downward from the average or estimated product yield.

gs1:productionDate.label: Production Date
gs1:productionDate.description: The production date is the production or assembly date determined by the manufacturer. The date may refer to the trade item itself or to items contained.

gs1:productionDateTime.label: Production Date and Time
gs1:productionDateTime.description: The date and time of production (or assembly). The date and time of production is determined by the manufacturer. The date and time may refer to the trade item itself or to the items contained.

gs1:productionVariantDescription.label: Production Variant Description
gs1:productionVariantDescription.description: Free text assigned by the manufacturer to describe the production variant. Examples are: package series X, package series Y.

gs1:productionVariantEffectiveDateTime.label: Production Variant Effective Date Time
gs1:productionVariantEffectiveDateTime.description: The start date of a production variant. The variant applies to products having a date mark (a best before date or expiration date) on the package that comes on or after the effective date.

gs1:proteinPerNutrientBasis.label: Protein Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:proteinPerNutrientBasis.description: Protein per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:provenanceStatement.label: Provenance Statement
gs1:provenanceStatement.description: Free text description of the region or place the product originates from. This is to be specifically used to specify areas such as cities, mountain ranges, regions. Examples: Made in the Thuringen Mountains, Made in Paris, From the Napa Valley.

gs1:purchaseSuppliesOrAccessories.label: Purchase supplies or accessories
gs1:purchaseSuppliesOrAccessories.description: A link to information about where supplies or accessories for the item can be purchased or ordered.

gs1:qualifyingBrandName.label: Qualifying Brand Name
gs1:qualifyingBrandName.description: If specified, the discount is only available when purchasing a product from one of the brand names specified via this property.

gs1:qualifyingGPCs.label: Qualifying Product GPC codes
gs1:qualifyingGPCs.description: If specified, the discount is only available when purchasing a product whose Global Product Classification (GPC) brick value appears in the list specified via this property.

gs1:qualifyingProductCategoryDescription.label: Qualifying Product Category Description
gs1:qualifyingProductCategoryDescription.description: If specified, the discount is only available when purchasing a product from categories specified in this free-form text field.

gs1:qualifyingProductClassificationCode.label: Qualifying Product Classification Code
gs1:qualifyingProductClassificationCode.description: If specified, the discount is only available when purchasing a product whose product classification (other than GPC) appears in the list specified via this property. This property specifies a product classification other than GPC.

gs1:qualifyingProductGTINs.label: Qualifying Product GTINs
gs1:qualifyingProductGTINs.description: If specified, the discount is only available when purchasing a product whose GTIN appears in the list specified via this property.

gs1:qualifyingSubBrandName.label: Qualifying Sub-brand Name
gs1:qualifyingSubBrandName.description: If specified, the discount is only available when purchasing a product from one of the sub-brand names (specified product ranges for a given brand) specified via this property.

gs1:quickStartGuide.label: Quick start guide
gs1:quickStartGuide.description: A link to a description of the key features needed to be understood to begin using the item or interacting with something new.

gs1:recallStatus.label: Recall status
gs1:recallStatus.description: A link to information about whether the product has been recalled or not, typically an API.

gs1:recipeInfo.label: Recipe website
gs1:recipeInfo.description: A link to a recipe website.

gs1:referencedFile.label: Has Referenced File
gs1:referencedFile.description: Link to a file or website containing additional information on product.

gs1:referencedFileEffectiveEndDateTime.label: Referenced File Effective End Date
gs1:referencedFileEffectiveEndDateTime.description: The date upon which the target of this external link ceases to be effective for use.

gs1:referencedFileEffectiveStartDateTime.label: Referenced File Effective Start Date
gs1:referencedFileEffectiveStartDateTime.description: The date upon which the target of this external link begins to be effective for use.

gs1:referencedFileSize.label: Referenced File Size
gs1:referencedFileSize.description: The size of the file as it is stored in an uncompressed format.

gs1:referencedFileType.label: Referenced File Type
gs1:referencedFileType.description: A code indicating the purpose or role of file (not a MIME type) that is being referenced, for example PRODUCT_LABEL_IMAGE. This code is used when the purpose of a file is not specified in the property.

gs1:referencedFileURL.label: Website
gs1:referencedFileURL.description: Simple text string that refers to a resource on the internet, URLs may refer to documents, resources, people, etc.

gs1:registerProduct.label: Register purchase
gs1:registerProduct.description: A link to an entry point for registering ownership of a product including for warranty purposes.

gs1:registryEntry.label: Entry in a register
gs1:registryEntry.description: A link to an entry in a register, such as a business register or register of locations. Such registers may act as alternative identifiers, such as official company numbers, LEIs, other location identifiers etc.

gs1:regulatedProductName.label: Regulated Product Name
gs1:regulatedProductName.description: The prescribed, regulated or generic product name or denomination that describes the true nature of the product. For example for a food product in order to distinguish it from other foods according to country specific regulations.

gs1:regulationType.label: Regulation Type
gs1:regulationType.description: Links to a code indicating the type of government regulation.

gs1:regulatoryAct.label: Regulatory Act
gs1:regulatoryAct.description: The name given to the requirement assigned by the regulatory agency.

gs1:regulatoryIdentifier.label: Regulatory Identifier
gs1:regulatoryIdentifier.description: Links to one or more groupings of identifiers that reference documents or datasets within a regulatory information system, repository or registry.

gs1:regulatoryIdentifierType.label: Regulatory Identifier Type
gs1:regulatoryIdentifierType.description: The code indicating the type of regulatory information that is referenced.

gs1:regulatoryInformation.label: Regulatory Information
gs1:regulatoryInformation.description: Links to one or more groupings of information on applicable government regulations applicable to a trade item.

gs1:regulatoryInformationProvider.label: Regulatory Information Provider
gs1:regulatoryInformationProvider.description: The organisation that provided a document or dataset to a regulatory information system, repository or registry.

gs1:regulatoryReferenceApplicabilityEndD.label: Regulatory Reference Applicability End Date
gs1:regulatoryReferenceApplicabilityEndD.description: The final date for which the referenced information remains applicable.

gs1:regulatoryReferenceApplicabilityStar.label: Regulatory Reference Applicability Start Date
gs1:regulatoryReferenceApplicabilityStar.description: The earliest date from which the referenced information becomes applicable.

gs1:regulatoryReferenceNumber.label: Regulatory Reference Number
gs1:regulatoryReferenceNumber.description: A reference number for a record, document or dataset stored within a regulatory information system, repository or registry.

gs1:regulatoryVerificationNumber.label: Regulatory Verification Number
gs1:regulatoryVerificationNumber.description: A verification number for a record, document or dataset stored within a regulatory information system, repository or registry, typically used in combination with the reference number when requesting access to the refrenced document or dataset.

gs1:reheatingClaim.label: Reheating Claim
gs1:reheatingClaim.description: Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging whether a food product which is ready to eat can be reheated if required prior to consumption.

gs1:relatedImage.label: Related image
gs1:relatedImage.description: A link to any image that depicts or relates to the identified entity (e.g., trade item, assets, business process, patient record, location, organisation, etc.)

gs1:relatedOrganization.label: Has Organisation
gs1:relatedOrganization.description: The organisation(s) associated with a place.

gs1:relatedVideo.label: Related video
gs1:relatedVideo.description: A link to any video, or document that has an embedded video, that describes or relates to the identified item, organisation, or location in some way.

gs1:replacedByOrganization.label: Replaced by organization
gs1:replacedByOrganization.description: Links to the successor organisation that is used in place of a previous organisation

gs1:replacedByPlace.label: Replaced by Place
gs1:replacedByPlace.description: Links to the successor location that is used in place of a previous location

gs1:replacedByProduct.label: Has Replaced By Product
gs1:replacedByProduct.description: The product which permanently replaces the current product. This product is sent in the record for the original item that is being replaced.

gs1:replacedOrganization.label: Replaced organization
gs1:replacedOrganization.description: Links to the previous organisation that this organisation replaces

gs1:replacedPlace.label: Replaced Place
gs1:replacedPlace.description: Links to the previous location that this location replaces

gs1:replacedProduct.label: Has Replaced Product
gs1:replacedProduct.description: Indicates the product identification of an item that is being permanently replaced by this product.

gs1:reportFound.label: Report found
gs1:reportFound.description: A link to a platform or service where users (company or a person) can report a found item associated with the identified entity (instance of an item). This link type is designed to assist in connecting the found item with its rightful owner or relevant authorities.

gs1:responsibility.label: Responsibility
gs1:responsibility.description: Text further specifying the area of responsibility of the trade contact.

gs1:responsibleForLocation.label: Responsible for location
gs1:responsibleForLocation.description: Links to the place(s) for which this organisation is responsible.

gs1:responsibleOrganization.label: Organisation responsible for the location
gs1:responsibleOrganization.description: Links to the organisation that is directly responsible for this place.

gs1:returnablePackageDepositAmount.label: Returnable Package Deposit Amount
gs1:returnablePackageDepositAmount.description: The monetary amount for the individual returnable package.

gs1:returnablePackageDepositRegion.label: Returnable Package Deposit Region
gs1:returnablePackageDepositRegion.description: The geographic region associated with the returnable package deposit amount.

gs1:riboflavinPerNutrientBasis.label: Riboflavin Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:riboflavinPerNutrientBasis.description: Riboflavin per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:saltPerNutrientBasis.label: Salt Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:saltPerNutrientBasis.description: Salt per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:saturatedFatPerNutrientBasis.label: Saturated Fat Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:saturatedFatPerNutrientBasis.description: Saturated fat per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:scheduleTime.label: Scheduling/Reservation
gs1:scheduleTime.description: A link to a site that offers information on scheduling, appointments, or reservations. This may or may not allow the user to book the reservation.

gs1:seasonCalendarYear.label: Season Calendar Year
gs1:seasonCalendarYear.description: The calendar year in which the product is seasonally available.

gs1:seasonName.label: Season Name
gs1:seasonName.description: Element defines the season applicable to the item for example Winter.

gs1:seasonParameter.label: Season Parameter
gs1:seasonParameter.description: Code indicating the season in which the product is available, e.g. SPRING, WINTER

gs1:selectedProductsOnly.label: Selected Products Only
gs1:selectedProductsOnly.description: If specified and set to true, the discount only applies to specific products selected by the retailer or offer promoter - not to all items in that product category. This property should be asserted and set to true for offers that say 'on selected products'.

gs1:seleniumPerNutrientBasis.label: Selenium Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:seleniumPerNutrientBasis.description: Selenium per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:sellByDate.label: Sell By Date
gs1:sellByDate.description: The date specified by the manufacturer as the last date the retailer is to offer the product for sale to the consumer. The product should not be merchandised after this date.

gs1:seller.label: Seller
gs1:seller.description: The organization seeking to sell a product or service.

gs1:serviceInfo.label: Service information
gs1:serviceInfo.description: A link to service or maintenance instructions.

gs1:servingSize.label: Serving Size
gs1:servingSize.description: Measurement value specifying the serving size in which the information per nutrient has been stated. Example: Per 100 GRM.

gs1:servingSizeDescription.label: Serving Size Description
gs1:servingSizeDescription.description: A free text field specifying the serving size for which the nutrient information has been stated for example: per 1/3 cup (42 g).

gs1:servingSuggestion.label: Serving Suggestion
gs1:servingSuggestion.description: Free text field for serving suggestion.

gs1:sharpnessOfCheese.label: Sharpness Of Cheese
gs1:sharpnessOfCheese.description: The descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the sharpness of the taste of the product for example EXTRA_SHARP. Usually the longer the aging of the product, the sharper the taste.

gs1:siteAccessRequirements.label: Site Access Requirements
gs1:siteAccessRequirements.description: A URI value linking to information related to requirements for accessing or visiting a place.

gs1:size.label: Size
gs1:size.description: Links a wearable product to one or more groupings of gs1:SizeDetails representing size systems, size groups, size type and size dimensions.

gs1:sizeCode.label: Size Code
gs1:sizeCode.description: Links a product to one or more groupings of gs1:SizeCodeDetails representing the size value from a specified code list.

gs1:sizeCodeListCode.label: Size Code List Code
gs1:sizeCodeListCode.description: Code specifying a size code list. Allowed code values are specified in GS1 Code List SizeCodeListCode .

gs1:sizeCodeValue.label: Size Code
gs1:sizeCodeValue.description: A code indicating the size of an object according to a specific code list. The applied code list is specified as additional information together with the size code.

gs1:sizeDimension.label: Size Dimension
gs1:sizeDimension.description: The numerical size measurement relating to the size type.

gs1:sizeGroup.label: Size Group
gs1:sizeGroup.description: Code indicating the type of size that is necessary to uniquely specify the size of the item, for example, BOYS.

gs1:sizeSystem.label: Size System
gs1:sizeSystem.description: The system that is being used to define the size for example EUROPE. Size system is used in conjunction with size group to define the size dimension.

gs1:sizeType.label: Size Type
gs1:sizeType.description: The type of size dimension being specified for example SLEEVE.

gs1:smartLabel.label: SmartLabel
gs1:smartLabel.description: A link to the product's SmartLabel page.

gs1:smpc.label: Summary Product Characteristics (SmPC)
gs1:smpc.description: A link to Summary Product Characteristics. To be used specifically when linking to information for healthcare professionals.

gs1:socialMedia.label: Social media
gs1:socialMedia.description: A link to a social media channel. The title will typically be replaced by the name of the channel.

gs1:sodiumPerNutrientBasis.label: Sodium Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:sodiumPerNutrientBasis.description: Sodium per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:sourceAnimal.label: Source Animal Code
gs1:sourceAnimal.description: Code indicating the source of raw material used to produce the food product, for example a GOAT for milk.

gs1:sportingActivityType.label: Sporting Activity Type
gs1:sportingActivityType.description: Code indicating the type of sporting activity for which the product is intended to be worn, for example FOOTBALL.

gs1:starchPerNutrientBasis.label: Starch Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:starchPerNutrientBasis.description: Starch per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:statisticInfo.label: Statistics
gs1:statisticInfo.description: A link to information about statistics regarding an organisation, location, or other entity.

gs1:statusTimestamp.label: Status Timestamp
gs1:statusTimestamp.description: Date and time (including optional timezone) associated to status designations. Timestamps may be future dated to provide advance notice of status changes. For further information about the required lexical representation of date, time, and timezone please see https://www.w3.org/TR/xmlschema-2/#dateTime

gs1:streetAddress.label: Street Address
gs1:streetAddress.description: The street address expressed as free form text. The street address is printed on paper as the first lines below the name. For example, the name of the street and the number in the street or the name of a building. A total of four street address lines are available. gs1:streetAddress SHOULD be used before populating lines two through four. For a PO Box gs1:postOfficeBoxNumber SHOULD be used instead.

gs1:streetAddressLine2.label: Street Address Line 2
gs1:streetAddressLine2.description: The second line of the street address, expressed as free form text. The street address is printed on paper as the first lines below the name. For example, the name of the street and the number in the street or the name of a building. A total of four street address lines are available. gs1:streetAddress SHOULD be used before populating lines two through four. These SHALL NOT be used as alternatives to the dedicated address properties gs1:addressSuburb, gs1:addressLocality and gs1:addressRegion.

gs1:streetAddressLine3.label: Street Address Line 3
gs1:streetAddressLine3.description: The third line of the street address, expressed as free form text. The street address is printed on paper as the first lines below the name. For example, the name of the street and the number in the street or the name of a building. A total of four street address lines are available. gs1:streetAddress and gs1:streetaddressLine2 SHOULD be used before populating lines three and four. These SHALL NOT be used as alternatives to the dedicated address properties gs1:addressSuburb, gs1:addressLocality and gs1:addressRegion.

gs1:streetAddressLine4.label: Street Address Line 4
gs1:streetAddressLine4.description: The fourth line of the street address, expressed as free form text. The street address is printed on paper as the first lines below the name. For example, the name of the street and the number in the street or the name of a building. gs1:streetAddress, gs1:streetaddressLine2 and gs1:streetaddressLine3 SHOULD be used before populating line four. These SHALL NOT be used as alternatives to the dedicated address properties gs1:addressSuburb, gs1:addressLocality and gs1:addressRegion.

gs1:styleDescription.label: Style Description
gs1:styleDescription.description: An attribute that classifies products that share many of the same characteristics (attribute values) that does NOT vary by GTIN, and are presented by the supplier as a single merchandise selection for the buyer.

gs1:subBrandName.label: Sub-brand Name
gs1:subBrandName.description: Second level of brand. Can be a trademark. It is the primary differentiating factor that a brand owner wants to communicate to the consumer or buyer. E.g. Yummy-Cola Classic. In this example Yummy-Cola is the brand and Classic is the sub-brand.

gs1:subOrganization.label: Sub-Organization
gs1:subOrganization.description: Designates a legal entity or function directly below the organisation/party being identified in a hierarchy. There may be multiple sub-organisations associated to a single GLN. To specify other affiliated organisations, see gs1:manages, gs1:franchisorOf, gs1:owns. To specify a parent organisation, see gs1:parentOrganization.

gs1:subscribe.label: Subscribe
gs1:subscribe.description: A link to a subscription form

gs1:sugarsPerNutrientBasis.label: Sugars Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:sugarsPerNutrientBasis.description: Sugars per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:supplierSpecifiedMinimumConsumerStor.label: Supplier Specified Minimum Consumer Storage Days
gs1:supplierSpecifiedMinimumConsumerStor.description: Represents the number of days between a product's sell by date and its use by date.

gs1:support.label: Support
gs1:support.description: A link to a source of support such as a helpdesk, chat support, email etc.

gs1:sustainabilityInfo.label: Sustainability and recycling
gs1:sustainabilityInfo.description: A link to information relating to sustainability and recycling requirements or processes.

gs1:sweetnessLevelOfAlcoholicBeverage.label: Sweetness level of alcoholic beverage
gs1:sweetnessLevelOfAlcoholicBeverage.description: Indicates the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the sweetness of the alcoholic beverage. These are sometimes placed on a label. In some markets, the term is based on the amount of sugar content according to local regulation.

gs1:targetConsumerAge.label: Target Consumer Age
gs1:targetConsumerAge.description: Identifies the target consumer age range for which a product has been designed.

gs1:targetConsumerGender.label: Target Consumer Gender
gs1:targetConsumerGender.description: Identifies the target consumer gender for which a product has been designed for example MALE

gs1:targetMarket.label: Has Target Market
gs1:targetMarket.description: Relates to a set of target market details (product release date and associated countries)

gs1:targetMarketCountries.label: Target Market Countries
gs1:targetMarketCountries.description: List of countries representing the target market for a particular release date indicated by gs1:consumerFirstAvailabilityDateTime

gs1:textileMaterial.label: Has Textile Material
gs1:textileMaterial.description: One or more links to information about the materials used in a wearable product.

gs1:textileMaterialContent.label: Textile Material Content
gs1:textileMaterialContent.description: A description of the material composition used in conjunction with the material percentage.

gs1:textileMaterialDescription.label: Textile Description
gs1:textileMaterialDescription.description: This provides a name or brief description of one material contained within the product, for example Rayon.

gs1:textileMaterialPercentage.label: Textile Material Percentage
gs1:textileMaterialPercentage.description: Corresponding net weight percentage of the product material specified via gs1:textileMaterialDescription, e.g. 70.

gs1:textileMaterialThreadCount.label: Textile Material Thread Count
gs1:textileMaterialThreadCount.description: The quality of material (fabric) of a product based on the total number of vertical and horizontal threads in one square inch.

gs1:textileMaterialWeight.label: Textile Material Weight
gs1:textileMaterialWeight.description: The measured weight of the material expressed in ounces per square yard or grams per square meter.

gs1:thiaminPerNutrientBasis.label: Thiamin Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:thiaminPerNutrientBasis.description: Thiamin per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:traceability.label: Traceability information
gs1:traceability.description: A link to traceability information (includes track and trace). Traceability information may be provided for consumption by humans or computers. If the target is an EPCIS repository, use gs1:epcis instead.

gs1:transFatPerNutrientBasis.label: Trans Fat Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:transFatPerNutrientBasis.description: Trans Fat per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:transactionDate.label: Transaction Date
gs1:transactionDate.description: The date associated with a business transaction

gs1:transactionID.label: Transaction Reference
gs1:transactionID.description: An identifier for a business transactions

gs1:transactionType.label: Transaction Reference
gs1:transactionType.description: The code indicating the type of business transactions

gs1:tutorial.label: Tutorial
gs1:tutorial.description: A link to a tutorial or set of tutorials, such as online classes, how-to videos etc.

gs1:unitCode.label: Measurement Unit
gs1:unitCode.description: A string value indicating a Measurement Unit from UN/ECE Recommendation 20, Units of Measure used in International Trade e.g. GRM = gram - see http://www.unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/cefact/recommendations/rec20/rec20_rev3_Annex3e.pdf

gs1:upperMaterialType.label: Has Upper Material
gs1:upperMaterialType.description: The material(s) used for the upper part of the footwear product. The upper is the part of a shoe, boot, slipper or other item of footwear that is above the sole.

gs1:userAgreement.label: Sign waiver/agreement/document
gs1:userAgreement.description: A link to an agreement or waiver.

gs1:usesManagedLocation.label: Uses managed location
gs1:usesManagedLocation.description: Links to the place(s) that this organisation uses as a managed space.

gs1:validFrom.label: Valid From
gs1:validFrom.description: The effective start date of the price .

gs1:validThrough.label: Valid Through
gs1:validThrough.description: The effective end date of the price .

gs1:value.label: Measurement Value
gs1:value.description: A floating-point numeric value that is qualified by the corresponding measurement unit code - see gs1:unitCode

gs1:variantDescription.label: Variant Description
gs1:variantDescription.description: Free text field used to identify the variant of the product. Variants are the distinguishing characteristics that differentiate products with the same brand and size including such things as the particular flavour, fragrance, taste.

gs1:verificationService.label: Verification Service
gs1:verificationService.description: A link to a GS1 Lightweight Messaging Service for verifying the status of a product, organisation, or location and its identifier.

gs1:vintner.label: Vintner
gs1:vintner.description: The person hired by a winery or wine company who is responsible for many of the processes in the preparation, taste and quality of the wine produced. The science of wine making is referred to as oenology. The vintner is the oenologist.

gs1:vitaminAPerNutrientBasis.label: Vitamin A Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
gs1:vitaminAPerNutrientBasis.description: Vitamin A per specified nutrient basis quantity.

gs1:vitaminB12PerNutrientBasis.label: Vitamin B12 Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
